model.name: Travel_Hospitality
model.description: travel hospitality industry enterprise data model.

domains.name: guest
domains.description: Single source of truth for guest identity, profiles, preferences, contact information, demographics, stay history, and segmentation across all properties and brands. Manages individual travelers, corporate accounts, group contacts, and VIP profiles. Supports FIT, corporate, and group guest types. Integrates with CRM (Salesforce) and loyalty platforms for unified guest view and lifetime value tracking.

products.name: profile
products.description: Single source of truth for guest identity and master profile data across all properties and brands. Captures individual traveler identity including full name, date of birth, nationality, passport/ID details, gender, language preference, and VIP status flag. Stores profile source system origin, creation property, last-updated timestamp, merge survivor status, and active/inactive lifecycle state. Sourced from Oracle OPERA PMS (Guest Profiles) and Salesforce CRM. Serves FIT, corporate, and group guest types. The authoritative golden record for all guest identity resolution, cross-property recognition, and lifetime value tracking. All other guest-domain products reference this entity as their parent.

attributes.name: profile_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the guest master profile record in the lakehouse silver layer. This is the primary key and golden record anchor for all guest identity resolution across properties and brands. Role: MASTER_PARTY.
attributes.references: Oracle OPERA PMS Guest Profiles Module

attributes.name: creation_property_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to property.property. Business justification: Guest profiles are created at a specific property (front desk enrollment, loyalty sign-up). Property-level CRM reporting, loyalty enrollment attribution, and profile origin audits require a proper FK

attributes.name: loyalty_member_id
attributes.description: add column loyalty_member_id (BIGINT) with FK to loyalty.member.member_id - guest profiles should directly reference their loyalty membership for unified guest view

attributes.name: merged_into_profile_id
attributes.description: When profile_status = 'merged', this field references the survivor profile_id into which this record was consolidated. Enables audit trail of merge lineage and supports identity resolution queries across the guest domain.
attributes.references: Oracle OPERA PMS Guest Profiles; GDPR Article 5 (Data Accuracy)

attributes.name: accessibility_needs
attributes.description: Free-text or coded description of the guest's accessibility requirements (e.g., wheelchair accessible room, roll-in shower, hearing loop, visual impairment aids). Drives ADA-compliant room assignment and service delivery. Treated as sensitive personal data.
attributes.references: ADA (Americans with Disabilities Act); GDPR Article 9 (Special Category Data); Oracle OPERA PMS Guest Profiles

attributes.name: birth_date
attributes.description: The guest's date of birth in ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-dd). Used for age verification, birthday recognition programs, loyalty tier benefits, and regulatory identity verification at check-in.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4; CCPA Section 1798.140; ADA Compliance; Oracle OPERA PMS Guest Profiles

attributes.name: company_name
attributes.description: The name of the company or corporate account associated with this guest profile. Used for corporate rate eligibility, billing to master accounts, and corporate segment analytics. Applicable primarily to CORPORATE guest type.
attributes.references: Oracle OPERA PMS Guest Profiles; Salesforce CRM Account Management

attributes.name: country_of_residence_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: Guest Country of Residence Code (ISO 3166-1 Alpha-3)
attributes.description: The guest's country of permanent residence as an ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 code. Distinct from nationality; used for geographic segmentation, GDPR/CCPA jurisdiction determination, and source market analytics.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1 Alpha-3; GDPR Article 4; CCPA; Oracle OPERA PMS Guest Profiles

tag_set.value: Guest Country of Residence Code (ISO 3166-1 Alpha-3)

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when the guest master profile record was first created in the source system of record (Oracle OPERA PMS or Salesforce CRM). Expressed in ISO 8601 format with timezone offset. Satisfies RECORD_AUDIT_CREATED requirement for MASTER_PARTY role.
attributes.references: Oracle OPERA PMS Guest Profiles; Salesforce CRM; GDPR Article 5 (Data Accuracy); SOX Section 404

attributes.name: crm_contact_reference
attributes.description: The native contact identifier assigned by Salesforce CRM for this guest. Enables bi-directional synchronization between the PMS golden record and the CRM guest profile for marketing, loyalty, and case management workflows.

attributes.name: data_privacy_consent_date
attributes.description: The date on which the guest provided or last renewed their data privacy consent. Required for GDPR and CCPA compliance audit trails, consent expiry management, and regulatory reporting.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 7; CCPA Section 1798.120; Oracle OPERA PMS Guest Profiles; Salesforce CRM

attributes.name: email
attributes.description: The primary email address for the guest used for reservation confirmations, pre-arrival communications, loyalty program notifications, and post-stay surveys via Medallia. Subject to GDPR and CCPA consent management.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4; CCPA Section 1798.140; PCI DSS; Oracle OPERA PMS Guest Profiles; Salesforce CRM

attributes.name: email_opt_in
attributes.description: Granular consent flag specifically for email marketing communications, separate from the overall marketing opt-in. Supports channel-specific consent management as required by GDPR, CCPA, and CAN-SPAM regulations.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 7; CCPA Section 1798.120; CAN-SPAM Act; Salesforce CRM Consent Management

attributes.name: family_name
attributes.description: The guest's legal family name (surname) as captured at check-in or profile creation. Used for identity verification, folio generation, and cross-property guest recognition.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4; CCPA Section 1798.140; Oracle OPERA PMS Guest Profiles

attributes.name: gdpr_erasure_requested
attributes.business_glossary_term: GDPR Right to Erasure Request Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the guest has submitted a GDPR Article 17 Right to Erasure (Right to be Forgotten) request. True = erasure request received and pending or in-process. Triggers data suppression workflows and prevents further marketing processing.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 17 (Right to Erasure); CCPA Section 1798.105; Salesforce CRM Privacy Management

tag_set.value: GDPR Right to Erasure Request Flag

attributes.name: gender
attributes.description: The guest's self-identified gender code: M=Male, F=Female, X=Non-binary/Other, U=Undisclosed. Used for personalization, regulatory reporting in certain jurisdictions, and demographic analytics.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 9; Oracle OPERA PMS Guest Profiles; AHLA Diversity Standards

attributes.name: given_name
attributes.description: The guest's legal given name (first name) as captured at check-in or profile creation. Used for personalized guest recognition, folios, and correspondence across all properties.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4; CCPA Section 1798.140; Oracle OPERA PMS Guest Profiles

attributes.name: guest_type
attributes.description: Classification of the guest by travel purpose and booking relationship: FIT (Free Independent Traveler), CORPORATE (business traveler under corporate account), GROUP (group block participant), CREW (airline/transport crew), TRAVEL_AGENT, VIP. Drives rate eligibility, service protocols, and reporting segmentation. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: FIT|CORPORATE|GROUP|CREW|TRAVEL_AGENT|VIP|WHOLESALE|GOVERNMENT — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Oracle OPERA PMS Guest Profiles; AHLA Industry Classification; STR Segmentation Standards

attributes.name: is_merge_survivor
attributes.description: Indicates whether this profile record is the surviving (golden) record following a guest profile merge operation. True = this is the authoritative survivor record; False = this is a source or non-survivor record. Critical for identity resolution and deduplication governance.
attributes.references: Oracle OPERA PMS Guest Profiles; Salesforce CRM Data Quality Standards; GDPR Article 5 (Data Accuracy)

attributes.name: job_title
attributes.description: The professional job title of the guest as provided during profile creation or CRM synchronization. Supports corporate account management, MICE event coordination, and personalized service delivery for business travelers.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Guest Profiles; Oracle OPERA PMS Guest Profiles

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp of the most recent modification to the guest profile record in the source system. Used for change data capture (CDC), ETL incremental loads, and audit trail compliance.
attributes.references: Oracle OPERA PMS Guest Profiles; Salesforce CRM; GDPR Article 5; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: loyalty_enrollment_date
attributes.description: The date on which the guest enrolled in the loyalty program. Used to calculate member tenure, tier qualification windows, and anniversary recognition benefits.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Loyalty Management Module; AHLA Loyalty Program Standards

attributes.name: loyalty_tier
attributes.description: The guest's current loyalty program tier level, determining benefit eligibility, upgrade priority, and service recognition protocols. Tiers progress from NONE (non-member) through SILVER, GOLD, PLATINUM, to DIAMOND (highest).
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Loyalty Management Module; AHLA Loyalty Program Standards

attributes.name: marketing_opt_in
attributes.description: Indicates whether the guest has provided explicit consent to receive marketing communications (email, SMS, direct mail). True = opted in; False = opted out or no consent given. Mandatory for GDPR and CCPA compliance in marketing campaign execution.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 6 (Lawful Basis); GDPR Article 7 (Consent); CCPA Section 1798.120; CAN-SPAM Act; Salesforce CRM Consent Management

attributes.name: middle_name
attributes.description: The guest's middle name or initial as provided. Supports full legal name matching for identity verification, passport validation, and regulatory compliance.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4; Oracle OPERA PMS Guest Profiles

attributes.name: mobile_phone
attributes.description: The guest's mobile/cell phone number in E.164 format. Used for SMS pre-arrival messaging, mobile check-in notifications, and digital key delivery.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4; CCPA Section 1798.140; ITU-T E.164; Oracle OPERA PMS Guest Profiles

attributes.name: name_prefix
attributes.description: Honorific or salutation prefix for the guest (e.g., Mr, Mrs, Dr). Used in personalized correspondence, folio headers, and VIP recognition communications. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: Mr|Mrs|Ms|Miss|Dr|Prof|Sir|Rev — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Oracle OPERA PMS Guest Profiles; AHLA Guest Experience Standards

attributes.name: name_suffix
attributes.description: Name suffix for the guest (e.g., Jr., Sr., III, PhD). Supports full legal name representation for identity documents and formal correspondence.

attributes.name: nationality_country_code
attributes.description: The guest's nationality expressed as an ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 three-letter country code (e.g., USA, GBR, DEU). Required for regulatory reporting, visa compliance, and international guest analytics.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1 Alpha-3; GDPR Article 4; Oracle OPERA PMS Guest Profiles; AHLA Regulatory Compliance

attributes.name: opera_profile_reference
attributes.description: The native guest profile identifier assigned by Oracle OPERA Property Management System (PMS). Used for cross-system reconciliation and source-system traceability back to the PMS guest profile record.
attributes.references: Oracle OPERA PMS Guest Profiles Module

attributes.name: passport_expiry_date
attributes.description: The expiration date of the guest's passport document. Used to validate document currency at check-in and for regulatory compliance in jurisdictions requiring valid travel document verification.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 9; ICAO Doc 9303; Oracle OPERA PMS Guest Profiles

attributes.name: passport_issuing_country_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: Guest Passport Issuing Country Code (ISO 3166-1 Alpha-3)
attributes.description: The ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code of the authority that issued the guest's passport. Required for immigration compliance and international guest regulatory reporting.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1 Alpha-3; ICAO Doc 9303; Oracle OPERA PMS Guest Profiles

tag_set.value: Guest Passport Issuing Country Code (ISO 3166-1 Alpha-3)

attributes.name: passport_number
attributes.description: The guest's passport document number as presented at check-in. Required for international guest identity verification, regulatory reporting to local authorities, and compliance with immigration laws in applicable jurisdictions.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 9; ICAO Doc 9303; Oracle OPERA PMS Guest Profiles; Local Immigration Regulations

attributes.name: phone
attributes.description: The primary contact phone number for the guest in E.164 international format. Used for reservation confirmations, pre-arrival contact, and service recovery outreach.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4; CCPA Section 1798.140; ITU-T E.164; Oracle OPERA PMS Guest Profiles

attributes.name: preferred_bed_type
attributes.description: The guest's preferred bed configuration for room assignment: KING, QUEEN, DOUBLE, TWIN, or SINGLE. Used during pre-arrival room blocking and at check-in to maximize guest satisfaction.
attributes.references: Oracle OPERA PMS Guest Profiles; AHLA Room Configuration Standards

attributes.name: preferred_floor
attributes.description: The guest's preferred floor level or floor range for room assignment (e.g., high floor, low floor, specific floor number). Captured from guest preferences in OPERA PMS and used during pre-arrival room blocking.
attributes.references: Oracle OPERA PMS Guest Profiles; AHLA Guest Experience Standards

attributes.name: preferred_language_code
attributes.description: The guest's preferred communication language expressed as an ISO 639-1 two-letter language code (e.g., en, fr, de, zh). Drives language selection for folios, correspondence, digital communications, and on-property service delivery.
attributes.references: ISO 639-1; Oracle OPERA PMS Guest Profiles; Salesforce CRM; AHLA Guest Experience Standards

attributes.name: preferred_room_type
attributes.description: The guest's stated or historically derived preferred room type (e.g., King Deluxe, Suite, Double Queen). Stored as a room type code from the PMS room type configuration. Used by front desk for pre-arrival room assignment and upsell targeting.
attributes.references: Oracle OPERA PMS Guest Profiles; AHLA Room Type Classification Standards

attributes.name: profile_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the guest master profile: active (in use), inactive (dormant, no recent stays), merged (absorbed into a survivor record), suspended (temporarily blocked), deceased (confirmed deceased, retained for audit). Governs record visibility and processing eligibility.
attributes.references: Oracle OPERA PMS Guest Profiles; GDPR Article 17 (Right to Erasure); CCPA Section 1798.105

attributes.name: smoking_preference
attributes.description: The guest's smoking preference for room assignment: NON_SMOKING, SMOKING (where available), or NO_PREFERENCE. Used during pre-arrival room blocking and check-in assignment to comply with guest preferences and property smoking policies.
attributes.references: Oracle OPERA PMS Guest Profiles; OSHA Indoor Air Quality Standards; AHLA Guest Experience Standards

attributes.name: sms_opt_in
attributes.description: Granular consent flag specifically for SMS/text message marketing communications. Supports channel-specific consent management as required by GDPR, CCPA, and TCPA (Telephone Consumer Protection Act) regulations.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 7; CCPA Section 1798.120; TCPA; Salesforce CRM Consent Management

attributes.name: vip_status
attributes.description: The VIP designation level assigned to the guest in Oracle OPERA PMS, indicating the tier of elevated service protocols to apply at check-in and throughout the stay. NONE=standard guest, VIP1-VIP3=escalating VIP tiers, VVIP=highest recognition, BLACKLIST=do-not-accommodate flag.
attributes.references: Oracle OPERA PMS Guest Profiles; AHLA VIP Service Standards

products.name: contact_info
products.description: Authoritative repository of all guest contact details and postal addresses associated with a guest profile. Stores email addresses, phone numbers, mailing/billing/home addresses (with full international address structure including city, state, postal code, country per ISO 3166), and digital contact channels (social handles, messaging IDs). Supports multiple records per guest with type classification (primary, secondary, work, home), opt-in/opt-out flags for marketing communications, address validation status, and geocoordinates. Sourced from Salesforce CRM and OPERA PMS.

attributes.name: contact_info_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each guest contact information record in the Silver Layer lakehouse. Primary key for the contact_info data product. Sourced from Salesforce CRM and Oracle OPERA PMS guest profile modules.
attributes.references: OPERA PMS Guest Profile; Salesforce CRM Contact Object

attributes.name: profile_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent guest profile record to which this contact information belongs. Supports multiple contact records per guest (primary, secondary, work, home). Sourced from Oracle OPERA PMS guest profile and Salesforce CRM.
attributes.references: OPERA PMS Guest Profile; Salesforce CRM Contact Object

attributes.name: address_line1
attributes.description: Primary street address line for the guest's mailing, billing, or home address. Includes street number and street name. Used for billing correspondence, loyalty program mailings, and address validation. Sourced from OPERA PMS and Salesforce CRM.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4; CCPA; OPERA PMS Guest Profile; USPS Address Standards

attributes.name: address_line2
attributes.description: Secondary street address line for the guest's postal address. Captures apartment number, suite, floor, building name, or other secondary address components. Optional field used when the primary address line is insufficient.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4; CCPA; OPERA PMS Guest Profile; USPS Address Standards

attributes.name: address_type
attributes.description: Classification of the postal address indicating its purpose: home residence, billing address for invoices and folios, mailing address for correspondence, or work/corporate address. Determines which address is used for loyalty program mailings and billing statements.
attributes.references: OPERA PMS Guest Profile; Salesforce CRM Contact Object

attributes.name: address_validated_date
attributes.description: Date on which the postal address was last validated against an authoritative address verification service. Used to determine whether re-validation is required based on data freshness policies and returned mail events.
attributes.references: USPS Address Validation Standards; Universal Postal Union (UPU)

attributes.name: address_validation_status
attributes.description: Status of the postal address validation check performed against authoritative address databases (e.g., USPS, Royal Mail, Canada Post). Validated addresses improve direct mail deliverability and reduce returned loyalty program correspondence.
attributes.references: USPS Address Validation Standards; Universal Postal Union (UPU); OPERA PMS Guest Profile

attributes.name: bounce_reason
attributes.description: Reason code for why a contact record has been marked as bounced or undeliverable. Hard bounces indicate permanent delivery failures (invalid email/address); soft bounces indicate temporary failures. Used to maintain list hygiene and comply with email deliverability best practices.
attributes.references: CAN-SPAM Act; CASL; Salesforce CRM Marketing Cloud; GDPR Article 5

attributes.name: city
attributes.description: City or municipality of the guest's postal address. Used for geographic segmentation, demand forecasting by feeder market, and targeted marketing campaigns. Part of the full international address structure.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4; CCPA; ISO 3166-2; OPERA PMS Guest Profile

attributes.name: contact_channel
attributes.description: The communication channel category this contact record represents: email, phone, postal address, social media handle, or digital messaging platform. Enables multi-channel guest communication strategy and analytics.
attributes.references: HTNG Guest Profile Standards; Salesforce CRM Contact Object

attributes.name: contact_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of this contact record. Active records are used for communications; bounced or undeliverable records indicate failed delivery attempts; suppressed records are excluded from all outbound communications per regulatory or guest request. Sourced from Salesforce CRM and OPERA PMS.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 5; CCPA; Salesforce CRM Contact Object; OPERA PMS Guest Profile

attributes.name: contact_type
attributes.description: Classification of the contact record indicating its role relative to the guest profile. Determines which record is used for reservation confirmations, marketing communications, billing, and emergency notifications. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: primary|secondary|work|home|billing|emergency — promote to reference product if additional types are required]
attributes.references: OPERA PMS Guest Profile; Salesforce CRM Contact Object

attributes.name: country_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code for the guest's address (e.g., USA, GBR, DEU). Used for international address formatting, GDPR/CCPA jurisdiction determination, feeder market analytics, and channel distribution reporting.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1 Alpha-3; GDPR Article 4; CCPA; OPERA PMS Guest Profile

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this contact information record was first created in the system of record. Conforms to ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Used for data lineage, GDPR consent audit trails, and data quality monitoring.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 30; ISO 8601; OPERA PMS; Salesforce CRM

attributes.name: data_retention_expiry_date
attributes.description: Date on which this contact record is scheduled for deletion or anonymization per the applicable data retention policy. Calculated based on the last guest interaction date plus the retention period defined by GDPR, CCPA, or local data protection regulations. Supports automated data lifecycle management.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 5(1)(e) (storage limitation); CCPA; AHLA Data Privacy Guidelines

attributes.name: do_not_contact
attributes.description: Indicates that the guest has explicitly requested no contact via this channel, regardless of opt-in status. Overrides all marketing and transactional communication flags. Must be honored immediately upon receipt per GDPR Article 21 (right to object) and CCPA.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 21; CCPA; CAN-SPAM Act; CASL; Salesforce CRM Contact Object

attributes.name: email_address
attributes.description: Guest email address used for reservation confirmations, pre-arrival communications, loyalty program notifications, and marketing campaigns. Sourced from Salesforce CRM and OPERA PMS. Subject to GDPR, CCPA opt-in/opt-out controls.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4; CCPA; OPERA PMS Guest Profile; Salesforce CRM

attributes.name: email_type
attributes.description: Classification of the email address indicating whether it is a personal, work/corporate, or other email account. Supports segmentation for FIT versus corporate guest communications and loyalty program targeting.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Contact Object; OPERA PMS Guest Profile

attributes.name: gdpr_lawful_basis
attributes.business_glossary_term: General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) Lawful Basis
attributes.description: The GDPR Article 6 lawful basis under which this contact record is processed. Required for all guest contact data belonging to EU/EEA residents. Consent is the most common basis for marketing; contract is the basis for transactional communications related to reservations.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 6; GDPR Article 13 & 14 (transparency); AHLA Data Privacy Guidelines

tag_set.value: General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) Lawful Basis

attributes.name: is_primary
attributes.description: Indicates whether this contact record is the designated primary contact for the guest within its channel type. Only one record per guest per channel should be flagged as primary. Used by CRS and PMS for reservation confirmations and pre-arrival communications.
attributes.references: OPERA PMS Guest Profile; Sabre SynXis CRS

attributes.name: is_verified
attributes.description: Indicates whether this contact record has been verified through a confirmation process (e.g., email verification link, phone OTP, address validation). Verified contacts have higher data quality confidence and are preferred for critical communications such as reservation confirmations.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 5 (data accuracy); OPERA PMS Guest Profile; Salesforce CRM

attributes.name: language_code
attributes.description: IETF BCP 47 language tag indicating the guest's preferred language for communications sent to this contact address (e.g., en-US, fr-FR, zh-CN). Drives localized email templates, pre-arrival messaging, and loyalty program communications.
attributes.references: IETF BCP 47; ISO 639-1; OPERA PMS Guest Profile; Salesforce CRM

attributes.name: latitude
attributes.description: Geographic latitude coordinate of the guest's postal address in decimal degrees (WGS 84 datum). Supports geocoded feeder market analysis, drive-time radius marketing campaigns, and property proximity analytics for targeted offers.

attributes.name: longitude
attributes.description: Geographic longitude coordinate of the guest's postal address in decimal degrees (WGS 84 datum). Used in conjunction with latitude for geocoded feeder market analysis, proximity-based marketing, and demand origin mapping.

attributes.name: marketing_opt_in
attributes.description: Indicates whether the guest has provided explicit consent to receive marketing communications via this contact channel. True = opted in; False = opted out or no consent given. Mandatory for GDPR and CCPA compliance. Drives suppression lists in Salesforce CRM marketing campaigns.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 6 & 7; CCPA; CAN-SPAM Act; CASL; Salesforce CRM Marketing Cloud

attributes.name: marketing_opt_in_date
attributes.description: Date on which the guest provided explicit consent to receive marketing communications via this contact channel. Required for GDPR audit trail and consent management. Stored to demonstrate lawful basis for processing under GDPR Article 6.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 6 & 7; CCPA; CAN-SPAM Act; Salesforce CRM Consent Management

attributes.name: marketing_opt_out_date
attributes.description: Date on which the guest withdrew consent or opted out of marketing communications via this contact channel. Required for GDPR and CCPA compliance audit trail. Once set, this contact record must be excluded from all outbound marketing campaigns.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 7(3); CCPA; CAN-SPAM Act; Salesforce CRM Consent Management

attributes.name: messaging_handle
attributes.description: Guest's account identifier or phone number on the specified digital messaging platform. Used to initiate pre-arrival, in-stay, and post-stay communications via messaging channels. Subject to GDPR and CCPA as a digital contact identifier.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4; CCPA; HTNG Guest Messaging Standards

attributes.name: messaging_platform
attributes.description: Digital messaging platform through which the guest can be contacted (e.g., WhatsApp, WeChat, LINE, SMS). Supports pre-arrival messaging, in-stay service requests, and post-stay follow-up communications per guest opt-in preferences.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4; CCPA; HTNG Guest Messaging Standards

attributes.name: opt_in_source
attributes.description: The channel or touchpoint through which the guest provided their marketing or transactional communication consent. Used for consent audit trails and channel attribution analysis. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: web|mobile_app|front_desk|call_center|ota|loyalty_enrollment|other — promote to reference product if additional sources are required]
attributes.references: GDPR Article 7; CCPA; Salesforce CRM Consent Management

attributes.name: phone_country_code
attributes.description: International dialing country code prefix for the guest phone number (e.g., +1 for USA, +44 for UK). Stored separately to support international call routing and country-level analytics. Conforms to ITU-T E.164 country code standards.

attributes.name: phone_number
attributes.description: Guest phone number in E.164 international format. Used for reservation confirmations, pre-arrival calls, service recovery, and emergency contact. Sourced from OPERA PMS and Salesforce CRM. Subject to GDPR and CCPA data protection requirements.
attributes.references: ITU-T E.164; GDPR Article 4; CCPA; OPERA PMS Guest Profile

attributes.name: phone_type
attributes.description: Classification of the phone number indicating whether it is a mobile, home, work, or fax number. Determines eligibility for SMS marketing communications and pre-arrival text notifications per guest opt-in preferences.
attributes.references: OPERA PMS Guest Profile; Salesforce CRM Contact Object

attributes.name: postal_code
attributes.description: Postal or ZIP code of the guest's address. Supports address validation, geographic clustering for feeder market analysis, and targeted direct mail campaigns. Format varies by country (e.g., 5-digit US ZIP, alphanumeric UK postcode).
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4; CCPA; Universal Postal Union (UPU) Standards; OPERA PMS Guest Profile

attributes.name: social_handle
attributes.description: Guest's username or handle on the specified social media platform. Used for social CRM engagement, service recovery via social channels, and digital marketing personalization. Subject to GDPR and CCPA as a digital identifier.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4; CCPA; Salesforce CRM Social Studio

attributes.name: social_platform
attributes.description: Name of the social media platform associated with the guest's social handle or digital identity record. Used for social CRM integration, guest experience personalization, and digital marketing channel attribution. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: twitter|instagram|facebook|linkedin|wechat|line|tiktok|other — promote to reference product if additional platforms are required]
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Social Studio; GDPR Article 4

attributes.name: source_system_record_code
attributes.description: The native identifier of this contact record in the originating operational system (e.g., Salesforce Contact ID, OPERA profile contact sequence number). Enables bidirectional traceability between the Silver Layer lakehouse and source systems for reconciliation and data quality audits.
attributes.references: OPERA PMS Guest Profile; Salesforce CRM Contact Object; GDPR Article 30

attributes.name: state_province
attributes.description: State, province, or administrative region of the guest's postal address per ISO 3166-2 subdivision codes. Used for regional marketing segmentation, tax jurisdiction determination, and CCPA compliance scope identification.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-2; GDPR Article 4; CCPA; OPERA PMS Guest Profile

attributes.name: transactional_opt_in
attributes.description: Indicates whether the guest has consented to receive transactional communications (reservation confirmations, folio receipts, check-in instructions) via this contact channel. Distinct from marketing opt-in; transactional messages may have a separate legal basis under GDPR.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 6(1)(b); OPERA PMS; Sabre SynXis CRS

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this contact information record was last modified in the system of record. Conforms to ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Used for change data capture (CDC), ETL incremental loads, and data freshness monitoring in the Silver Layer.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 30; ISO 8601; OPERA PMS; Salesforce CRM

attributes.name: verified_date
attributes.description: Date on which this contact record was last verified through a confirmation process. Used to assess data freshness and trigger re-verification workflows when contact data exceeds the data quality policy threshold.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 5 (data accuracy); OPERA PMS Guest Profile; Salesforce CRM

products.name: preference
products.description: Guest preference records capturing stated and inferred preferences across all hospitality touchpoints. Includes room preferences (floor level, bed type, smoking/non-smoking, view type), pillow type, amenity preferences, F&B dietary restrictions and allergies, newspaper preferences, housekeeping schedule preferences, temperature settings, and special accommodation needs (ADA requirements). Sourced from OPERA PMS and Salesforce CRM. Critical for personalized service delivery and pre-arrival preparation.

attributes.name: preference_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for a guest preference record in the Silver Layer lakehouse. Primary key for the preference data product within the guest domain.
attributes.references: Oracle OPERA PMS Guest Profile Module

attributes.name: facility_id

attributes.description: Reference to the loyalty program membership record associated with this VIP guest. Links VIP designation entitlements with loyalty tier benefits to ensure non-duplication and correct benefit stacking. Sourced from Salesforce CRM loyalty management module.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Loyalty Management; AHLA Loyalty Program Standards

attributes.name: profile_id
attributes.description: Reference to the guest profile record for whom this VIP designation is assigned. Links to the master guest profile in the guest domain. A single guest may hold multiple concurrent VIP designations across brand and property levels.
attributes.references: Oracle OPERA PMS Guest Profile Module; Salesforce CRM Guest Object

attributes.name: property_id
attributes.description: Reference to the property at which this VIP designation applies. A designation may be property-specific (e.g., Celebrity at a single resort) or brand-wide (null indicates brand-level designation). Sourced from Oracle OPERA PMS property configuration.
attributes.references: Oracle OPERA PMS Property Configuration; AHLA Property Standards

attributes.name: room_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to inventory.room. Business justification: High-profile VIP designations (heads of state, celebrities) often require a specific physical room to be pre-blocked (e.g., Presidential Suite = room 2001). Linking vip_designation to room_id enables

attributes.name: tier_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to loyalty.tier. Business justification: Hotel operations auto-assign VIP protocols based on loyalty tier (e.g., Platinum → VIP Level 3). A direct FK from vip_designation to loyalty.tier enables automated VIP assignment workflows, tier-to-VI

attributes.name: airport_transfer_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether a complimentary or arranged airport transfer service is required for this VIP guest as part of their designation entitlements. Triggers coordination with the concierge and transportation team during pre-arrival preparation.
attributes.references: Oracle OPERA PMS Pre-Arrival Checklist; AHLA Concierge Service Standards

attributes.name: alias_name
attributes.description: Pseudonym or alias name used for incognito check-in and reservation bookings to protect the identity of high-profile guests. Used in place of the guest's legal name on folios, room assignments, and staff communications when incognito_checkin is true.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 5; CCPA Section 1798.100; Oracle OPERA PMS Guest Profile Privacy Fields

attributes.name: amenity_tier_code
attributes.description: Code referencing the amenity entitlement package associated with this VIP level. Determines the standard amenity setup (e.g., welcome fruit basket, champagne, floral arrangement, personalized stationery) to be prepared prior to guest arrival. Sourced from OPERA PMS amenity configuration.
attributes.references: Oracle OPERA PMS Amenity Configuration; AHLA Guest Experience Standards

attributes.name: concurrent_designation_count
attributes.description: Number of active VIP designations currently held by this guest across all scopes (brand and property level). Supports operational awareness that a guest may hold multiple concurrent designations (e.g., VIP3 at brand level and Celebrity at property level) and ensures all applicable protocols are honored.
attributes.references: Oracle OPERA PMS VIP Code Table; AHLA Guest Experience Standards

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this VIP designation record was first created in the silver layer lakehouse. Represents the audit trail creation event. Formatted as yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX per platform conventions.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 5 (data accountability); SOX Section 404 (audit trail); ISO 27001

attributes.name: designation_code
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric code identifying this VIP designation record, as assigned in Oracle OPERA PMS VIP code table (e.g., VIP1, VIP3, CELEB, ROYAL, OWNER). Used for cross-system reference and pre-arrival checklist triggers.
attributes.references: Oracle OPERA PMS VIP Code Table; HTNG Guest Profile Standards

attributes.name: designation_notes
attributes.description: Internal narrative notes providing additional context about the VIP designation, such as the relationship history, specific events that triggered the designation, or instructions for the guest relations team. Visible only to authorized staff. Sourced from Salesforce CRM case notes.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Case Management; GDPR Article 5; CCPA Section 1798.100

attributes.name: designation_reason
attributes.description: Business rationale for granting the VIP designation. Revenue threshold indicates the guest meets a minimum annual spend threshold. Corporate relationship indicates a key account or contracted corporate partner. Public figure, diplomatic, and celebrity reasons trigger additional privacy protocols. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: revenue_threshold|corporate_relationship|public_figure|loyalty_elite|owner|board_member|celebrity|diplomatic|media|government — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM VIP Classification; AHLA Guest Experience Standards; GDPR Article 5

attributes.name: designation_scope
attributes.description: Indicates whether the VIP designation applies across the entire brand portfolio, is restricted to a specific property, or applies to a regional cluster of properties. Drives which properties must honor the designation during pre-arrival preparation.
attributes.references: Oracle OPERA PMS VIP Code Table; HTNG Guest Profile Standards

attributes.name: designation_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the VIP designation record. Active designations drive pre-arrival checklists and upgrade eligibility. Suspended designations are temporarily paused. Revoked designations have been withdrawn due to policy violation or relationship change.
attributes.references: Oracle OPERA PMS VIP Code Table; Salesforce CRM VIP Status Field

attributes.name: do_not_disturb
attributes.description: Indicates that the guest has a standing do-not-disturb preference that must be honored by housekeeping, engineering, and all operational departments unless a safety emergency arises. Overrides standard housekeeping scheduling in Oracle OPERA PMS.
attributes.references: Oracle OPERA PMS Housekeeping Configuration; OSHA Safety Standards

attributes.name: effective_from
attributes.description: Calendar date on which the VIP designation becomes active and service protocols are triggered. Used to schedule pre-arrival preparation and amenity entitlements. Aligns with OPERA PMS VIP code validity start date.
attributes.references: Oracle OPERA PMS VIP Code Validity; HTNG Guest Profile Standards

attributes.name: effective_until
attributes.description: Calendar date on which the VIP designation expires and service protocols are deactivated. Null indicates an open-ended designation with no planned expiry. Annual review cycles typically reset this date. Aligns with OPERA PMS VIP code validity end date.
attributes.references: Oracle OPERA PMS VIP Code Validity; HTNG Guest Profile Standards

attributes.name: gm_greeting_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether the General Manager (GM) or designated senior property leader is required to personally greet this VIP guest upon arrival. Triggers a GM greeting task in the pre-arrival preparation checklist within Oracle OPERA PMS.
attributes.references: Oracle OPERA PMS Pre-Arrival Checklist; AHLA Guest Experience Standards

attributes.name: incognito_checkin
attributes.description: Indicates that the guest requires a discreet, incognito check-in process to protect their identity and privacy. When true, the front desk must use a private check-in area, suppress the guest name from public-facing displays, and limit staff awareness of the guest's presence. Critical for celebrity and diplomatic guests.
attributes.references: Oracle OPERA PMS Privacy Flags; GDPR Article 5; CCPA Section 1798.100

attributes.name: last_stay_date
attributes.description: Date of the guest's most recent completed stay at any property under this VIP designation's scope. Used during annual VIP review cycles to assess continued eligibility based on recency of engagement. Sourced from Oracle OPERA PMS reservation history.
attributes.references: Oracle OPERA PMS Reservation History; AHLA Guest Loyalty Standards

attributes.name: media_blackout
attributes.description: Indicates that all media inquiries, press requests, and social media references related to this guest's stay must be suppressed and escalated to the Director of Communications. Distinct from no_photo_policy as it governs external communications rather than on-property photography.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 5; CCPA Section 1798.100; AHLA Communications Standards

attributes.name: no_photo_policy
attributes.description: Indicates that the guest has explicitly prohibited photography, video recording, or any visual documentation of their presence on property. Staff must be briefed on this restriction during pre-arrival preparation. Applies to celebrity, royalty, and diplomatic designations.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 9; CCPA Section 1798.100; AHLA Guest Privacy Standards

attributes.name: pre_arrival_checklist_template
attributes.description: Code identifying the standardized pre-arrival preparation checklist template to be activated for this VIP designation. Templates define the sequence of tasks (amenity setup, room inspection, GM briefing, transportation coordination) required before the guest's arrival.
attributes.references: Oracle OPERA PMS Pre-Arrival Task Management; AHLA Guest Experience Standards

attributes.name: revenue_threshold_amount
attributes.description: Minimum annual revenue contribution (in USD) that qualified this guest for the VIP designation based on the revenue threshold reason. Used for annual VIP eligibility reviews and LTV (Lifetime Value) analysis. Sourced from OPERA PMS revenue history and SAP S/4HANA financial records.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Finance GL; USALI Revenue Classification; AHLA Revenue Standards

attributes.name: revenue_threshold_currency
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the revenue_threshold_amount field. Ensures correct currency context for multi-currency properties and international guests. Defaults to USD for US-based properties.
attributes.references: ISO 4217 Currency Codes; SAP S/4HANA Multi-Currency Configuration

attributes.name: review_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date for the next periodic review of this VIP designation to confirm continued eligibility based on revenue thresholds, relationship status, or public figure standing. Supports annual VIP audit processes managed by the guest relations team.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM VIP Review Workflow; AHLA Guest Experience Standards

attributes.name: revocation_reason
attributes.description: Reason code explaining why a VIP designation was revoked or suspended. Populated only when designation_status is revoked or suspended. Supports audit trail requirements and VIP eligibility governance reviews. Sourced from Salesforce CRM case closure reason.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Case Management; SOX Internal Controls; AHLA Guest Relations Governance

attributes.name: room_assignment_priority
attributes.description: Numeric priority rank (lower value = higher priority) used by the front desk and revenue management systems to sequence room assignment and upgrade eligibility for this VIP guest relative to other arriving guests. Integrates with IDeaS G3 RMS inventory controls.
attributes.references: Oracle OPERA PMS Room Assignment; IDeaS G3 RMS Inventory Controls

attributes.name: security_escort_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether a dedicated security escort or personal protection detail coordination is required for this VIP guest during their stay. Triggers security briefing and coordination protocols with the property security team and any external protection services.
attributes.references: AHLA Safety and Security Standards; OSHA Workplace Safety

attributes.name: service_recovery_escalation_level
attributes.description: Defines the escalation path and response urgency for service recovery incidents involving this VIP guest. Immediate_gm requires the General Manager to be notified within minutes of any complaint. Drives Medallia case routing and Salesforce CRM service recovery workflows.
attributes.references: Medallia Service Recovery Module; Salesforce CRM Case Management; AHLA Guest Satisfaction Standards

attributes.name: source_system_vip_code
attributes.description: The native VIP code or identifier as stored in the originating source system (Oracle OPERA PMS or Salesforce CRM). Retained for traceability and reconciliation between the lakehouse silver layer and the operational system of record.
attributes.references: Oracle OPERA PMS VIP Code Table; Salesforce CRM VIP Field; HTNG Data Exchange Standards

attributes.name: special_handling_notes
attributes.description: Free-text field capturing bespoke service instructions specific to this VIP designation, such as preferred room temperature, dietary restrictions for amenity setup, security escort requirements, or specific staff interaction protocols. Sourced from Salesforce CRM case notes and OPERA PMS profile remarks.
attributes.references: Oracle OPERA PMS Profile Remarks; Salesforce CRM Case Management; AHLA Guest Experience Standards

attributes.name: total_stays_in_period
attributes.description: Count of completed stays by the guest within the current designation validity period (effective_from to effective_until). Used to validate continued VIP eligibility at review date and to support LTV (Lifetime Value) reporting. Sourced from Oracle OPERA PMS stay history.
attributes.references: Oracle OPERA PMS Stay History; USALI Guest Statistics; AHLA Loyalty Standards

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to this VIP designation record in the silver layer lakehouse. Tracks changes to designation status, special handling instructions, privacy flags, or host assignments. Formatted as yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX per platform conventions.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 5 (data accountability); SOX Section 404 (audit trail); ISO 27001

attributes.name: upgrade_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether this VIP designation entitles the guest to complimentary room category upgrades subject to availability at check-in. When true, the front desk system surfaces upgrade options during the check-in workflow in Oracle OPERA PMS.
attributes.references: Oracle OPERA PMS Upgrade Rules; AHLA Guest Experience Standards

attributes.name: vip_level
attributes.description: Tiered classification of the VIP designation indicating the service protocol level assigned to the guest. VIP1 is entry-level recognition; VIP5 is the highest standard tier. Celebrity, Royalty, Owner, and Board Member are special-class designations. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: VIP1|VIP2|VIP3|VIP4|VIP5|Celebrity|Royalty|Owner|Board Member — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Oracle OPERA PMS VIP Code Table; AHLA Guest Experience Standards

products.name: stay_history
products.description: Consolidated historical record of all completed guest stays across all properties and brands. Captures arrival date, departure date, property, room type, room number, rate plan, ADR, total revenue (rooms + F&B + ancillary), LOS, number of guests, booking channel, and stay outcome (completed, early departure, extended). Sourced from OPERA PMS post-checkout records. Foundational for LTV calculation, segmentation, and personalization. Distinct from active reservations managed in the reservation domain.

attributes.name: stay_history_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each completed guest stay record in the silver layer lakehouse. Primary key for the stay_history data product. Sourced from Oracle OPERA PMS post-checkout records.

attributes.name: channel_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to channel.channel. Business justification: Channel attribution on actual stay outcomes (ADR, LOS, ancillary revenue by channel) is a fundamental hospitality revenue management and channel performance report. stay_history.booking_channel_code i

attributes.name: corporate_account_id
attributes.description: Reference to the corporate account associated with this stay, applicable when guest_type is 'corporate'. Links to negotiated rate agreements and corporate travel program tracking. Sourced from Oracle OPERA PMS accounts receivable module.

attributes.name: event_booking_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to event.event_booking. Business justification: MICE room block pickup reporting and group revenue attribution: individual guest stays generated by a group/event room block must be linked to the originating event_booking to track block pickup rate,

attributes.name: group_block_id
attributes.description: Reference to the group block associated with this stay, applicable when guest_type is 'group'. Links to group contract, pickup tracking, and group revenue attribution. Sourced from Oracle OPERA PMS group module.
attributes.references: Oracle OPERA PMS; Delphi by Amadeus

attributes.name: market_segment_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to revenue.market_segment. Business justification: Revenue managers attribute actual stay revenue to market segments for USALI segment performance reporting, ADR analysis, and demand forecasting calibration. Every hospitality revenue system links stay

attributes.name: member_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to loyalty.member. Business justification: Loyalty points posting, tier qualification calculation, and stay-credit attribution all require joining stay_history directly to the member record. loyalty_member_number is a denormalized surrogate; r

attributes.name: profile_id
attributes.description: Reference to the guest profile record representing the primary registered guest for this stay. Supports Lifetime Value (LTV) calculation, segmentation, and personalization across all properties.

attributes.name: property_id
attributes.description: Reference to the property where the stay occurred. Enables property-level performance analytics including ADR, RevPAR, and OCC reporting per USALI standards.

attributes.name: revenue_rate_plan_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to revenue.revenue_rate_plan. Business justification: Rate plan performance analysis — revenue managers must link actual stays to the rate plan consumed to measure rate plan ADR contribution, LOS compliance, and yield effectiveness. Every PMS stay record

attributes.name: room_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to inventory.room. Business justification: Room-level performance reporting (maintenance correlation with guest complaints, housekeeping quality by room, repeat-room preference tracking) requires linking stay history to the specific physical r

attributes.name: room_type_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to inventory.room_type. Business justification: Post-stay analytics and revenue reporting require linking stay history to room type: which room types drive highest ADR, NPS, loyalty points earned. room_type_code on stay_history is a denormalized re

attributes.name: segment_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to guest.segment. Business justification: Each completed stay is classified under a market segment (e.g., Corporate, Leisure, Group, OTA). Adding segment_id → segment.segment_id links the stay record to the authoritative segment definition, e

attributes.name: adr
attributes.description: Average Daily Rate (ADR) for the stay, calculated as total room revenue divided by the number of occupied room nights. A primary KPI per USALI and STR STAR Report standards. Expressed in the property's local currency. Used for RevPAR computation and competitive benchmarking via STR.
attributes.references: USALI; STR STAR Report; Oracle OPERA PMS

attributes.name: ancillary_revenue
attributes.description: Total ancillary charges posted to the guest folio during the stay, including spa, parking, laundry, telephone, and other non-room, non-F&B charges. Sourced from Oracle OPERA PMS. Contributes to TRevPAR and GOPPAR calculations per USALI.

attributes.name: arrival_date
attributes.description: Actual date the guest checked in to the property (yyyy-MM-dd). May differ from the originally reserved arrival date in cases of early arrival or late arrival. Used as the principal business event date for stay analytics and STR benchmarking.
attributes.references: Oracle OPERA PMS; STR STAR Report

attributes.name: booking_date
attributes.description: Date on which the reservation was originally created (yyyy-MM-dd). Used to calculate booking lead time (days between booking_date and arrival_date), a key input for demand forecasting and pickup report analysis.
attributes.references: Oracle OPERA PMS; Sabre SynXis CRS; IDeaS G3 RMS

attributes.name: checkin_timestamp
attributes.description: Exact date and time the guest completed the check-in process at the front desk or via mobile/digital check-in (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Sourced from Oracle OPERA PMS front desk module. Used for operational SLA tracking and guest experience analytics.

attributes.name: checkout_timestamp
attributes.description: Exact date and time the guest completed the checkout process (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Sourced from Oracle OPERA PMS cashiering module. Marks the point at which the stay record is finalized and posted to the stay history.

attributes.name: complimentary_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the stay was provided on a complimentary (no-charge) basis (True = complimentary; False = revenue-generating stay). Sourced from Oracle OPERA PMS. Used for USALI complimentary room reporting and GOP calculation.

attributes.name: confirmation_number
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric confirmation number assigned by the Central Reservation System (CRS) or Property Management System (PMS) at time of booking. Used by guests and agents to reference the stay. Sourced from Sabre SynXis CRS or Oracle OPERA PMS.
attributes.references: Oracle OPERA PMS; Sabre SynXis CRS

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this stay history record was first created in the silver layer lakehouse, typically upon post-checkout processing from Oracle OPERA PMS (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Used for data lineage, audit trail, and ETL pipeline monitoring.
attributes.references: Oracle OPERA PMS; GDPR Article 5; SOX

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code in which all monetary amounts on this stay record are denominated (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP). Required for multi-currency properties and international financial reporting under IFRS/GAAP.

attributes.name: departure_date
attributes.description: Actual date the guest checked out of the property (yyyy-MM-dd). May differ from the originally reserved departure date in cases of early departure or extended stay. Used in conjunction with arrival_date to compute Length of Stay (LOS).
attributes.references: Oracle OPERA PMS; STR STAR Report

attributes.name: do_not_disturb_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the guest activated Do Not Disturb (DND) status during the stay (True = DND activated at any point; False = DND not activated). Sourced from Oracle OPERA PMS housekeeping module. Used for housekeeping scheduling and guest preference analytics.

attributes.name: fb_revenue
attributes.description: Total Food and Beverage (F&B) charges posted to the guest folio during the stay, including restaurant, bar, room service, and minibar charges. Sourced from Oracle Hospitality MICROS POS. Contributes to TRevPAR calculation.

attributes.name: gss_score
attributes.description: Overall Guest Satisfaction Score (GSS) for the stay as captured by Medallia post-stay survey, typically on a scale of 1-10 or 1-100 depending on survey instrument. Distinct from NPS; measures overall satisfaction rather than likelihood to recommend. Used for Satisfaction and Loyalty Tracking (SALT) reporting.

attributes.name: guest_type
attributes.description: Classification of the guest stay by traveler category. 'fit' (Free Independent Traveler) indicates leisure individual; 'corporate' indicates business traveler under a negotiated account; 'group' indicates part of a group block; 'crew' indicates airline or transport crew; 'complimentary' indicates no-charge stay. Drives segmentation and LTV modeling.

attributes.name: los_nights
attributes.description: Actual number of nights the guest stayed at the property, computed as departure_date minus arrival_date. A core metric for Average Length of Stay (ALOS) analysis, revenue management, and demand forecasting in IDeaS G3 RMS.
attributes.references: Oracle OPERA PMS; IDeaS G3 RMS; USALI

attributes.name: loyalty_points_earned
attributes.description: Number of loyalty program points earned by the guest for this stay, based on the applicable earning rate for the rate plan, room type, and member tier. Sourced from Salesforce CRM loyalty management. Used for loyalty program liability accrual and member engagement analytics.

attributes.name: loyalty_tier_at_stay
attributes.description: The guest's loyalty program tier level at the time of the stay (e.g., Silver, Gold, Platinum, Diamond). Captured as a snapshot to preserve historical tier context for LTV analysis and personalization, independent of the guest's current tier. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: promote to reference product as tiers vary by brand]

attributes.name: nps_score
attributes.description: Net Promoter Score (NPS) provided by the guest for this stay, on a scale of 0-10. Sourced from Medallia post-stay survey. Used for Guest Satisfaction Score (GSS) tracking, service recovery identification, and experience analytics. Null if guest did not respond to survey.

attributes.name: num_adults
attributes.description: Count of adult guests (18 years and older) registered for the stay as recorded in Oracle OPERA PMS. Used for occupancy reporting, F&B revenue forecasting, and capacity planning.

attributes.name: num_children
attributes.description: Count of child guests (under 18 years) registered for the stay as recorded in Oracle OPERA PMS. Used for family segment analytics, amenity planning, and F&B revenue forecasting.

attributes.name: original_arrival_date
attributes.description: The arrival date as originally reserved at time of booking, before any modifications. Used to measure early arrival or late arrival deviations and to support wash factor analysis in IDeaS G3 RMS.
attributes.references: Oracle OPERA PMS; IDeaS G3 RMS

attributes.name: original_departure_date
attributes.description: The departure date as originally reserved at time of booking, before any modifications. Used to identify early departure and extended stay patterns for demand forecasting and wash factor analysis in IDeaS G3 RMS.
attributes.references: Oracle OPERA PMS; IDeaS G3 RMS

attributes.name: payment_method
attributes.description: Primary payment instrument used to settle the guest folio at checkout. Sourced from Oracle OPERA PMS cashiering module. Used for payment mix analysis and PCI DSS compliance reporting. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: credit_card|debit_card|cash|direct_bill|loyalty_points|bank_transfer|voucher|cryptocurrency — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: qualifying_nights
attributes.description: Number of nights from this stay that count toward the guest's loyalty program tier qualification. May differ from los_nights if the rate plan is non-qualifying (e.g., wholesale, complimentary). Sourced from Salesforce CRM loyalty management.

attributes.name: room_revenue
attributes.description: Total room charges posted to the guest folio for the entire stay, excluding taxes, fees, and ancillary charges. Sourced from Oracle OPERA PMS cashiering module. Core component of RevPAR and TRevPAR calculations per USALI.

attributes.name: service_recovery_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a service recovery action was initiated during or after this stay (True = service recovery case opened; False = no service recovery). Sourced from Medallia or Salesforce CRM case management. Used for Guest Recovery Rate (GRR) calculation and experience analytics.

attributes.name: stay_status
attributes.description: Outcome status of the guest stay upon checkout processing. 'completed' indicates normal checkout on scheduled departure date; 'early_departure' indicates guest checked out before scheduled departure; 'extended' indicates stay was prolonged beyond original departure date; 'no_show' indicates reservation was not cancelled but guest never arrived; 'cancelled' indicates reservation was cancelled post-check-in processing.

attributes.name: tax_amount
attributes.description: Total tax charges applied to the guest folio for the stay, including occupancy tax, VAT, city tax, and other applicable levies. Sourced from Oracle OPERA PMS cashiering. Required for IFRS/GAAP financial reporting and SOX compliance.
attributes.references: Oracle OPERA PMS; IFRS/GAAP; SOX; USALI

attributes.name: total_folio_amount
attributes.description: Total amount charged to the guest folio for the entire stay, inclusive of room revenue, F&B revenue, ancillary revenue, and taxes. Represents the gross billing amount settled at checkout. Sourced from Oracle OPERA PMS cashiering module.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this stay history record was last modified in the silver layer lakehouse (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Captures post-checkout adjustments such as folio corrections, survey score updates, or loyalty point recalculations. Used for data lineage and audit compliance.
attributes.references: Oracle OPERA PMS; GDPR Article 5; SOX

attributes.name: vip_code
attributes.description: VIP designation code assigned to the guest for this stay in Oracle OPERA PMS (e.g., VIP1, VIP2, VVIP, CELEB). Drives special handling, amenity delivery, and management attention protocols. Null if guest has no VIP designation.

products.name: communication_consent
products.description: Guest communication consent and privacy preference records tracking opt-in/opt-out status for each communication channel and purpose. Captures consent type (marketing email, SMS, push notification, postal mail, phone), consent status, consent date, withdrawal date, consent source (web, front desk, CRM), jurisdiction (GDPR, CCPA, CASL), and legal basis for processing. Sourced from Salesforce CRM. Mandatory for regulatory compliance with GDPR and CCPA. Distinct from general contact info.

attributes.name: communication_consent_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the communication consent record. Primary key.

attributes.name: guest_profile_id
attributes.description: Reference to the guest profile who provided or withdrew consent. Links to the guest master record in CRM.

attributes.name: property_id
attributes.description: add column property_id (BIGINT) with FK to property.property.property_id - communication consents may be property-specific per jurisdiction

attributes.name: consent_audit_trail
attributes.description: Structured or semi-structured audit trail capturing the history of consent changes, including who made changes, when, and why. May be JSON or delimited text format.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 7 - Demonstrable Consent; SOX Internal Controls

attributes.name: consent_capture_url
attributes.description: The URL of the web page or application screen where the consent was captured. Helps trace back to the exact consent form version and context.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 7 - Demonstrable Consent; Internal Compliance Standards

attributes.name: consent_expiry_date
attributes.description: The date on which the consent expires and must be re-confirmed. Null for consents without expiration. Some jurisdictions and internal policies require periodic re-consent.
attributes.references: GDPR Recital 32 - Consent Refresh Best Practice; Internal Data Retention Policy

attributes.name: consent_granted_date
attributes.description: The date on which the guest provided explicit consent for the specified communication type and purpose. Critical for GDPR and CCPA compliance audit trails.

attributes.name: consent_granted_timestamp
attributes.description: Precise timestamp when consent was granted, including time zone information. Provides granular audit trail for regulatory compliance.

attributes.name: consent_language_code
attributes.description: Two-letter ISO 639-1 language code indicating the language in which the consent was presented and captured. Required for demonstrating informed consent in the guest native language.
attributes.references: ISO 639-1 Language Codes; GDPR Article 12 - Transparent Information

attributes.name: consent_method
attributes.description: The mechanism by which consent was captured. Distinguishes between explicit opt-in (GDPR-compliant), implicit opt-in, pre-checked box (non-compliant in many jurisdictions), verbal consent, written consent, or electronic signature.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4(11) - Definition of Consent; CCPA Regulations

attributes.name: consent_notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes providing additional context about the consent record. May include details about special circumstances, guest requests, or staff observations during consent capture.

attributes.name: consent_purpose
attributes.description: The business purpose for which the communication consent applies. Examples include marketing campaigns, promotional offers, transactional notifications, service updates, loyalty program communications, and guest satisfaction surveys.

attributes.name: consent_source
attributes.description: The channel or touchpoint through which the guest provided or withdrew consent. Examples include web form, mobile app, front desk during check-in, call center, email preference link, CRM manual entry by staff, loyalty program enrollment, or booking engine. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: web_form|mobile_app|front_desk|call_center|email_link|crm_manual_entry|loyalty_enrollment|booking_engine — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: GDPR Article 7(1) - Demonstrable Consent; Salesforce CRM Consent Management

attributes.name: consent_status
attributes.description: Current status of the guest consent. Indicates whether the guest has opted in, opted out, has a pending consent request, or if consent has expired or been revoked.

attributes.name: consent_text_version
attributes.description: Version identifier of the consent text or privacy policy that was presented to the guest at the time of consent. Enables audit trail of what terms the guest agreed to.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 7 - Conditions for Consent; Internal Compliance Standards

attributes.name: consent_type

products.name: identity_document

products.name: segment
products.description: Guest market segmentation master definitions and individual guest-to-segment assignment records. The master component defines business segments (transient, group, contract, wholesale, complimentary, crew) with segment code, name, hierarchy level, USALI mapping, and applicable rate strategy. The assignment component tracks individual guest-to-segment associations including assignment date, assignment method (rule-based, ML-inferred, manual override), confidence score, validity period, and superseding assignment reference. Sourced from OPERA PMS Market Segment codes, IDeaS G3 RMS, and Salesforce CRM segmentation. Used for RevPAR analysis, demand forecasting, targeted marketing, rate fence enforcement, and LTV-based prioritization. Note: this product contains both reference definitions and transactional assignments — the master definitions change infrequently while assignments are high-volume.

domains.name: reservation
domains.description: Core transactional domain managing the full booking lifecycle from inquiry through confirmation, modification, cancellation, and no-show management. Handles individual reservations, group blocks, and corporate bookings across all channels (direct, OTA, GDS, CRS). products.name: reservation_booking
products.description: Core master record for an individual guest reservation across all booking channels (direct, OTA, GDS, CRS via Sabre SynXis). Stores arrival/departure dates, LOS (Length of Stay), room type requested, rate code, BAR/LRA/NRR rate plan, guarantee method, booking status, source channel, CRS confirmation number, OPERA PMS reservation ID, number of adults/children, and special request flags. products.name: cancellation
