attributes.description: Unique business identifier or code for the allotment, used for tracking and reporting purposes in the Central Reservation System (CRS) and Property Management System (PMS).

attributes.name: commission_rate_percent
attributes.description: The commission percentage paid to the channel or partner for bookings made through this allotment. For example, 15.00 represents a 15% commission.

attributes.name: contract_reference
attributes.description: Reference number or identifier of the legal contract or agreement governing this allotment arrangement with the channel or partner.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this allotment record was first created in the Central Reservation System (CRS).

attributes.name: end_date
attributes.description: The last date on which this allotment is effective. Nullable for open-ended allotments.

attributes.name: expired_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this allotment expired and was no longer available for bookings. Nullable if not yet expired.

attributes.name: freesale_enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether the channel or partner can sell beyond the allocated quantity by accessing general inventory (True) or is restricted to the allocated quantity only (False). Freesale allows partners to sell from the hotel's available inventory without a fixed allotment limit.

attributes.name: freesale_threshold_quantity
attributes.description: The minimum number of rooms that must remain available in general inventory before freesale access is restricted or disabled for this allotment. Nullable if freesale is not enabled.

attributes.name: lra_enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether Last Room Availability (LRA) is enabled for this allotment, allowing the channel or partner to sell the last available room at the property (True) or restricting access when inventory is low (False).

attributes.name: max_los
attributes.description: The maximum number of nights a guest can book when reserving from this allotment. Nullable if no maximum Length of Stay (LOS) restriction applies.

attributes.name: min_los
attributes.description: The minimum number of nights a guest must book when reserving from this allotment. Nullable if no minimum Length of Stay (LOS) restriction applies.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this allotment record was last modified or updated.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Descriptive name for the allotment (e.g., 'Expedia Summer Block', 'Corporate XYZ Annual Contract').

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes or comments about this allotment, including special terms, conditions, or operational instructions.

attributes.name: overbooking_limit
attributes.description: The maximum number of rooms that can be overbooked for this allotment beyond the allocated quantity, used for yield optimization and revenue management. Nullable if overbooking is not permitted.

attributes.name: performance_threshold_percent
attributes.description: The minimum sell-through percentage required to maintain or increase the allotment quantity. For example, 80.00 means the partner must sell at least 80% of the allocated rooms to avoid reduction. Nullable if no performance threshold applies.

attributes.name: priority_rank
attributes.description: The priority ranking of this allotment relative to other allotments for the same room type and date range. Lower numbers indicate higher priority for inventory allocation. Used by Revenue Management System (RMS) for dynamic allocation.

attributes.name: release_period_days
attributes.description: The number of days before the arrival date by which unsold allotment inventory must be released back to general inventory. For example, a 7-day release period means unsold rooms are returned to the hotel 7 days before arrival.

attributes.name: sold_quantity
attributes.description: The number of rooms from this allotment that have been sold or reserved by the channel or partner.

attributes.name: start_date
attributes.description: The first date on which this allotment becomes effective and inventory is allocated to the channel or partner.

attributes.name: suspended_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this allotment was suspended or temporarily halted. Nullable if never suspended.

products.name: los_restriction
products.description: Length-of-Stay (LOS) restriction record defining minimum LOS (MinLOS), maximum LOS (MaxLOS), and full-pattern LOS requirements per room type per stay date and rate plan. Supports LOS-based revenue optimization strategies managed in IDeaS G3 RMS and distributed via Sabre SynXis CRS. Captures restriction type, effective date range, applicable channels, and override authority.
products.reference: IDeaS G3 LOS Controls / OPERA LOS Restrictions

attributes.name: los_restriction_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the length-of-stay restriction record. Primary key.

attributes.name: channel_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to channel.channel. Business justification: Channel-specific LOS restriction management: revenue managers apply minimum/maximum stay restrictions selectively by channel (e.g., min-stay only on OTAs, not direct). channel_code (plain text) is a d

attributes.name: currency_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to property.currency. Business justification: LOS restrictions track adr_threshold_amount and revpar_threshold_amount as monetary thresholds driving revenue strategy decisions; a currency FK to property.currency.currency_id is required for correc

attributes.name: dynamic_rate_rule_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to revenue.dynamic_rate_rule. Business justification: RMS dynamic rate rules generate LOS restrictions in the PMS as part of automated revenue optimization. Tracing los_restriction back to the triggering dynamic_rate_rule is essential for restriction aud

attributes.name: property_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the property to which this LOS restriction applies.

attributes.name: revenue_rate_plan_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the rate plan to which this LOS restriction applies. Nullable if restriction applies to all rate plans.
attributes.references: IDeaS G3 RMS Rate Plan Master

attributes.name: room_type_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the room type to which this LOS restriction applies.
attributes.references: Oracle OPERA PMS Room Type Master

attributes.name: tier_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to loyalty.tier. Business justification: LOS restrictions are routinely waived or modified by tier (platinum members exempt from 3-night minimums during peak demand). Revenue management systems need this to enforce tier-based restriction ove

attributes.name: adr_threshold_amount
attributes.description: ADR threshold amount that triggers or releases this LOS restriction. Used for rate-based restriction logic.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this LOS restriction record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: day_of_week_pattern
attributes.description: 7-character binary string indicating which days of the week this restriction applies to (1=applies, 0=does not apply). Format: SMTWTFS (Sunday through Saturday).

attributes.name: distribution_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this LOS restriction was last distributed to external channels via Sabre SynXis CRS or GDS connections.
attributes.references: Sabre SynXis CRS Distribution Log Standard

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: The last date on which this LOS restriction is active. Null indicates an open-ended restriction.
attributes.references: IDeaS G3 RMS Effective Date Standard

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: The first date on which this LOS restriction becomes active and enforceable.
attributes.references: IDeaS G3 RMS Effective Date Standard

attributes.name: forecast_demand_level
attributes.description: Forecasted demand level that triggered this LOS restriction: low, medium, high, or very high. Used for revenue optimization analytics.
attributes.references: IDeaS G3 RMS Demand Forecast Standard

attributes.name: full_pattern_los
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of exact LOS values allowed (e.g., '3,7,14' means only 3-night, 7-night, or 14-night stays are permitted). Null if restriction type is not full_pattern.
attributes.references: IDeaS G3 RMS Full-Pattern LOS Configuration

attributes.name: group_block_exempt_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether group block reservations are exempt from this LOS restriction. True if group blocks bypass this restriction, false otherwise.
attributes.references: Oracle OPERA PMS Group Block Standard

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this LOS restriction record was last modified.

attributes.name: loyalty_tier_exempt_list
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of loyalty program tier codes that are exempt from this LOS restriction (e.g., 'PLATINUM,DIAMOND'). Null if no loyalty exemptions apply.

attributes.name: lra_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this LOS restriction applies under Last Room Availability (LRA) conditions. True if restriction is enforced even when selling the last available room, false otherwise.

attributes.name: max_los
attributes.description: Maximum number of nights a guest may stay when this restriction is active. Null if restriction type is not max_los.

attributes.name: min_los
attributes.description: Minimum number of nights a guest must stay when this restriction is active. Null if restriction type is not min_los.

attributes.name: occ_threshold_percent
attributes.description: Occupancy percentage threshold that triggers or releases this LOS restriction. Expressed as a percentage (e.g., 85.00 for 85%).

attributes.name: override_authority_level
attributes.description: Minimum authority level required to override this LOS restriction during the reservation process: none (no override allowed), supervisor, manager, director, or general manager (GM).
attributes.references: Oracle OPERA PMS Authorization Level Standard

attributes.name: override_reason_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a documented reason is required when this LOS restriction is overridden. True if reason is mandatory, false otherwise.

attributes.name: priority_rank
attributes.description: Numeric rank indicating the priority of this restriction when multiple LOS restrictions apply to the same stay date and room type. Lower numbers indicate higher priority.
attributes.references: IDeaS G3 RMS Restriction Priority Standard

attributes.name: restriction_code
attributes.description: Business code identifying this LOS restriction rule for operational reference and reporting.
attributes.references: IDeaS G3 RMS Restriction Code Standard

attributes.name: restriction_notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes providing additional context, rationale, or special instructions for this LOS restriction. Used for operational communication and audit purposes.

attributes.name: restriction_status
attributes.description: Current operational status of this LOS restriction: active (enforced), inactive (not enforced), suspended (temporarily disabled), or pending (scheduled for future activation).
attributes.references: IDeaS G3 RMS Restriction Status Standard

attributes.name: restriction_type
attributes.description: Type of LOS restriction: minimum LOS (MinLOS), maximum LOS (MaxLOS), full-pattern LOS requirement, closed to arrival (CTA), or closed to departure (CTD).

attributes.name: revenue_strategy_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the revenue management strategy or campaign that generated this LOS restriction (e.g., PEAK_DEMAND, SHOULDER_SEASON, EVENT_DRIVEN).
attributes.references: IDeaS G3 RMS Revenue Strategy Standard

attributes.name: revpar_threshold_amount
attributes.business_glossary_term: Revenue Per Available Room (RevPAR) Threshold Amount
attributes.description: RevPAR threshold amount that triggers or releases this LOS restriction. Used for dynamic restriction management based on revenue performance.

tag_set.value: Revenue Per Available Room (RevPAR) Threshold Amount

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the system that created or last modified this LOS restriction: OPERA (Oracle OPERA PMS), IDEAS (IDeaS G3 RMS), SYNXIS (Sabre SynXis CRS), EZRMS (Infor EzRMS), or MANUAL (manual entry).

attributes.name: stay_date
attributes.description: The specific date for which this LOS restriction applies. Represents the arrival or stay-through date depending on restriction logic.

products.name: room_amenity
products.description: Master catalog of in-room amenities and features available by room type and individual room, including minibar contents, technology amenities (smart TV, Bluetooth speaker), bathroom fixtures, and premium bedding configurations. Tracks amenity installation date, condition, and replacement schedule.

attributes.name: room_amenity_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the room amenity record. Primary key for the room amenity catalog.
attributes.references: HTNG (Hotel Technology Next Generation) - Data Standards

attributes.name: currency_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to property.currency. Business justification: Room amenities track charge_amount and unit_cost requiring a proper currency reference for procurement cost analysis and guest billing across multi-currency properties. Both currency_code and cost_cur

attributes.name: parent_room_amenity_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing FK on room_amenity (parent_room_amenity_id)

attributes.name: property_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the property where this amenity is available. Links to the property master data.
attributes.references: USALI (Uniform System of Accounts for the Lodging Industry)

attributes.name: room_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the specific physical room where this amenity is installed. Null if amenity is defined at room type level only.
attributes.references: Oracle OPERA PMS - Room Management Module

attributes.name: room_type_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to inventory.room_type. Business justification: room_amenity product description states amenities are 'available by room type and individual room'. Currently only has FK to room (room_id). Many amenities are defined at room_type level (e.g., all De

attributes.name: tier_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to loyalty.tier. Business justification: Premium amenities (welcome gifts, premium minibar, turndown) are tier-restricted benefits. Operations teams need room_amenity.tier_id to enforce amenity eligibility by loyalty tier, support benefit fu

attributes.name: amenity_category
attributes.description: High-level classification of the amenity type for inventory management and guest preference tracking. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: technology|bathroom|bedding|minibar|furniture|climate_control|entertainment|connectivity — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: USALI (Uniform System of Accounts for the Lodging Industry) - FF&E Classification

attributes.name: amenity_code
attributes.description: Standardized code identifying the amenity type. Used for system integration and reporting consistency across properties.
attributes.references: HTNG (Hotel Technology Next Generation) - Amenity Code Standards

attributes.name: amenity_description
attributes.description: Detailed description of the amenity including brand, model, features, and guest-facing benefits. Used for marketing and guest communication.
attributes.references: HTNG (Hotel Technology Next Generation) - Content Standards

attributes.name: amenity_name
attributes.description: Business-friendly name of the amenity as displayed to guests and staff. Examples: Smart TV, Minibar, Espresso Machine, Premium Bedding.
attributes.references: HTNG (Hotel Technology Next Generation) - Guest-Facing Terminology Standards

attributes.name: brand_name
attributes.description: Manufacturer or brand name of the amenity. Important for luxury properties where brand recognition drives guest satisfaction.
attributes.references: FF&E (Furniture Fixtures and Equipment) Procurement Standards

attributes.name: charge_amount
attributes.description: Price charged to guest if amenity is consumed or used. Null for complimentary amenities. Used for minibar items and premium services.
attributes.references: USALI (Uniform System of Accounts for the Lodging Industry) - Revenue Standards

attributes.name: condition_status
attributes.description: Current physical condition of the amenity as assessed during last inspection. Drives maintenance and replacement decisions.
attributes.references: AHLA (American Hotel and Lodging Association) - Asset Condition Standards

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this amenity record was first created in the system. Used for audit trails and data lineage.

attributes.name: display_sequence
attributes.description: Sort order for displaying amenities in guest-facing interfaces and reports. Lower numbers appear first.
attributes.references: HTNG (Hotel Technology Next Generation) - User Interface Standards

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: Date after which this amenity configuration is no longer active. Null indicates no planned end date.
attributes.references: HTNG (Hotel Technology Next Generation) - Temporal Data Standards

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: Date from which this amenity configuration becomes active and available for guest use or booking display.
attributes.references: HTNG (Hotel Technology Next Generation) - Temporal Data Standards

attributes.name: guest_visible_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this amenity is displayed in guest-facing channels such as booking engines, mobile apps, and property websites. Used for marketing and distribution.
attributes.references: HTNG (Hotel Technology Next Generation) - Content Distribution Standards

attributes.name: installation_date
attributes.description: Date when the amenity was installed or placed in the room. Used for tracking asset age and planning replacement cycles.

attributes.name: is_ada_compliant

attributes.description: Indicates whether the amenity meets ADA accessibility requirements. Critical for compliance and guest accommodation matching.

tag_set.value: Is ADA (Americans with Disabilities Act) Compliant

attributes.name: is_complimentary
attributes.description: Indicates whether the amenity is provided at no additional charge to the guest. False indicates a chargeable amenity such as minibar items.
attributes.references: USALI (Uniform System of Accounts for the Lodging Industry) - Revenue Recognition

attributes.name: is_eco_friendly
attributes.description: Indicates whether the amenity meets environmental sustainability standards. Used for green certification programs and guest preference matching.
attributes.references: LEED (Leadership in Energy and Environmental Design) - Hospitality Standards

attributes.name: is_premium_amenity
attributes.description: Indicates whether this amenity is considered a premium or luxury feature that differentiates the room type and justifies higher ADR (Average Daily Rate).
attributes.references: Revenue Management Best Practices - Premium Feature Classification

attributes.name: last_inspection_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent inspection or condition assessment of the amenity. Critical for quality assurance and guest satisfaction.
attributes.references: AHLA (American Hotel and Lodging Association) - Quality Standards

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this amenity record was most recently updated. Used for change tracking and synchronization.

attributes.name: maintenance_frequency_days
attributes.description: Number of days between scheduled maintenance or inspection cycles for this amenity. Used for preventive maintenance scheduling.
attributes.references: AHLA (American Hotel and Lodging Association) - Preventive Maintenance Standards

attributes.name: model_number
attributes.description: Manufacturer model number or SKU for the amenity. Used for procurement, warranty tracking, and replacement ordering.
attributes.references: FF&E (Furniture Fixtures and Equipment) Asset Management Standards

attributes.name: next_scheduled_replacement_date
attributes.description: Planned date for replacing or refreshing the amenity based on lifecycle policy. Supports proactive FF&E capital planning.
attributes.references: FF&E (Furniture Fixtures and Equipment) Capital Planning Standards

attributes.name: operational_status
attributes.description: Current operational availability of the amenity. Inactive or out_of_service amenities are not available to guests.
attributes.references: Oracle OPERA PMS - Room Status Management

attributes.name: purchase_order_number
attributes.description: Purchase order reference number for the amenity acquisition. Used for financial reconciliation and audit trails.

attributes.name: quantity
attributes.description: Number of units of this amenity present in the room or room type. Example: 2 for pillows, 1 for minibar.
attributes.references: USALI (Uniform System of Accounts for the Lodging Industry) - Inventory Standards

attributes.name: special_instructions
attributes.description: Free-text field for operational notes, handling instructions, or guest communication guidelines related to the amenity.
attributes.references: Oracle OPERA PMS - Operational Notes Standards

attributes.name: unit_cost
attributes.description: Acquisition cost per unit of the amenity. Used for CapEx (Capital Expenditure) tracking and ROI (Return on Investment) analysis.
attributes.references: USALI (Uniform System of Accounts for the Lodging Industry) - CapEx Standards

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: Unit in which the amenity quantity is measured. Used for inventory tracking and replenishment.
attributes.references: USALI (Uniform System of Accounts for the Lodging Industry) - Inventory Standards

attributes.name: warranty_expiration_date
attributes.description: Date when manufacturer warranty coverage expires. Important for cost planning and vendor relationship management.
attributes.references: FF&E (Furniture Fixtures and Equipment) Warranty Management Standards

domains.name: revenue
domains.description: Authoritative source for pricing strategies, rate plans, yield optimization, and revenue performance. Manages BAR (Best Available Rate), dynamic pricing rules, DRR (Dynamic Rate Rules), rate restrictions, demand forecasting, and competitive benchmarking (STR STAR Report, RGI, MPI, ARI). Tracks ADR, RevPAR, TRevPAR, and GOPPAR metrics. Integrates with IDeaS G3 RMS and Infor EzRMS.
domains.references: STR STAR Report / USALI Revenue Standards

products.name: revenue_rate_plan
products.description: Master catalog of all rate plans available across properties, including BAR (Best Available Rate), LRA (Last Room Availability), NRR (Non-Refundable Rate), corporate negotiated rates, package rates, and promotional rates. Defines rate structure, cancellation policy, meal plan inclusions, booking conditions, and distribution eligibility. Sourced from IDeaS G3 RMS and Sabre SynXis CRS. This is the SSOT for rate plan definitions.

attributes.name: revenue_rate_plan_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each rate plan record in the revenue management system. Primary key for the revenue_rate_plan data product. Role: MASTER_RESOURCE.
attributes.references: IDeaS G3 RMS; Sabre SynXis CRS

attributes.name: distribution_channel_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to channel.channel. Business justification: Rate plans are distributed through specific channels (OTA, GDS, direct booking). Revenue managers configure which channels can sell which rate plans - core distribution strategy. Replaces denormalized

attributes.name: included_fnb_outlet_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to fnb.fnb_outlet. Business justification: Rate plans include F&B benefits (breakfast at specific outlet, dining credits). Required for package fulfillment, benefit tracking, revenue allocation between rooms and F&B departments per USALI stand

attributes.name: included_menu_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to fnb.menu. Business justification: Rate plans reference specific menus for included meals (breakfast menu version, dinner package menu). Required for package rate construction, menu version control, guest entitlement verification at ou

attributes.name: loyalty_tier_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to loyalty.tier. Business justification: Rate plans enforce tier-specific eligibility (loyalty_tier_required field exists). Business process: validating member tier qualification for rate plan access at booking time. Essential for tier-based

attributes.name: market_segment_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to revenue.market_segment. Business justification: revenue_rate_plan has a denormalized market_segment_code STRING field that references the market segment classification. Replacing this with a proper FK to revenue.market_segment.market_segment_id nor

attributes.name: property_id
attributes.description: Reference to the property or hotel at which this rate plan is applicable. Enables property-level rate plan management across a multi-property portfolio. A null value indicates a chain-wide or global rate plan applicable to all properties.
attributes.references: Oracle OPERA PMS; Sabre SynXis CRS

attributes.name: room_type_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific room type or room category to which this rate plan applies. A null value indicates the rate plan applies to all room types at the associated property.
attributes.references: Oracle OPERA PMS; IDeaS G3 RMS

attributes.name: advance_purchase_days
attributes.description: Minimum number of days prior to arrival that a booking must be made to qualify for this rate plan. Common values are 7, 14, 21, or 30 days for advance purchase promotional rates. A value of 0 indicates no advance purchase requirement.
attributes.references: IDeaS G3 RMS; Sabre SynXis CRS; Oracle OPERA PMS

attributes.name: approved_by
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the revenue manager or director who approved this rate plan for distribution. Supports SOX financial controls and internal audit requirements for rate authorization governance.
attributes.references: SOX; USALI; SAP S/4HANA; AHLA Revenue Management Best Practices

attributes.name: approved_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this rate plan was formally approved for activation and distribution. Distinct from created_timestamp; captures the authorization event in the rate plan lifecycle. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.
attributes.references: SOX; USALI; SAP S/4HANA; AHLA Revenue Management Best Practices

attributes.name: base_rate_amount
attributes.description: The principal nightly room rate amount in the operating currency before any adjustments, taxes, or fees. Represents the rack rate or floor price for this rate plan. Used as the reference value for ADR (Average Daily Rate) and RevPAR (Revenue Per Available Room) calculations. Satisfies MASTER_RESOURCE MEASUREMENT_OR_VALUE category.
attributes.references: IDeaS G3 RMS; USALI; STR STAR Report ADR methodology

attributes.name: booking_window_close_date
attributes.description: The last date on which new reservations can be made under this rate plan. After this date the rate plan is closed to new bookings even if the stay dates fall within the effective period.
attributes.references: IDeaS G3 RMS; Sabre SynXis CRS; Oracle OPERA PMS

attributes.name: booking_window_open_date
attributes.description: The earliest date on which reservations can be made under this rate plan. Used to control promotional rate availability windows and prevent premature booking of seasonal or event-driven rates.
attributes.references: IDeaS G3 RMS; Sabre SynXis CRS; Oracle OPERA PMS

attributes.name: cancellation_policy_code
attributes.description: Code referencing the cancellation and penalty policy associated with this rate plan (e.g., FLEX24H, NRR_NOREF, 48H_PENALTY). Determines guest refund eligibility and penalty charges upon cancellation. Critical for NRR (Non-Refundable Rate) and advance purchase rate plans.
attributes.references: Oracle OPERA PMS; Sabre SynXis CRS; AHLA Consumer Protection Guidelines

attributes.name: commission_pct
attributes.description: The percentage of the room rate payable as commission to the booking agent or OTA when is_commissionable is true. Expressed as a percentage (e.g., 10.00 for 10%). Null when is_commissionable is false.
attributes.references: Sabre SynXis CRS; SAP S/4HANA; AHLA Distribution Standards; USALI

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this rate plan record was first created in the source system. Used for audit trail, data lineage, and compliance reporting. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 5; SOX; USALI; Oracle OPERA PMS

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code in which the base_rate_amount and all monetary fields on this rate plan are denominated (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP). Required for multi-currency property portfolios.

attributes.name: discount_pct
attributes.description: Percentage discount applied to the BAR (Best Available Rate) or rack rate to derive this rate plan's selling price. Used for corporate negotiated rates, loyalty member rates, and promotional rates. A value of 0 indicates no discount from the reference rate.
attributes.references: IDeaS G3 RMS; Oracle OPERA PMS; USALI

attributes.name: drr_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether this rate plan is subject to DRR (Dynamic Rate Rule) adjustments by the revenue management system. When true, IDeaS G3 RMS or Infor EzRMS may automatically adjust the rate based on demand forecasts, occupancy levels, and competitive benchmarking.
attributes.references: IDeaS G3 RMS; Infor EzRMS; AHLA Revenue Management Best Practices

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: The calendar date from which this rate plan becomes active and bookable. Used by IDeaS G3 RMS and Sabre SynXis CRS to control rate availability windows. Satisfies MASTER_AGREEMENT EFFECTIVE_FROM category.
attributes.references: IDeaS G3 RMS; Sabre SynXis CRS; Oracle OPERA PMS

attributes.name: expiry_date
attributes.description: The calendar date after which this rate plan is no longer available for new bookings. Null indicates an open-ended rate plan with no defined end date. Satisfies MASTER_AGREEMENT EFFECTIVE_UNTIL category.
attributes.references: IDeaS G3 RMS; Sabre SynXis CRS; Oracle OPERA PMS

attributes.name: gds_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether this rate plan is distributed through GDS (Global Distribution System) channels such as Amadeus, Sabre, Travelport. Controls rate visibility to travel agents using GDS booking tools.
attributes.references: Sabre SynXis CRS; HTNG Channel Distribution Standards; AHLA

attributes.name: is_commissionable
attributes.description: Indicates whether a travel agent or OTA (Online Travel Agency) commission is payable on bookings made under this rate plan. Drives commission accrual and payment processing in SAP S/4HANA AP.
attributes.references: Sabre SynXis CRS; SAP S/4HANA; AHLA Distribution Standards

attributes.name: is_lra_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether this rate plan carries LRA (Last Room Availability) obligation, meaning the contracted rate must be honored even when only the last room in a category is available. Applicable to corporate negotiated rate contracts.
attributes.references: IDeaS G3 RMS; Sabre SynXis CRS; AHLA Corporate Rate Contracting Standards

attributes.name: is_refundable
attributes.description: Indicates whether bookings under this rate plan are eligible for a full refund upon cancellation within the policy window. False for NRR (Non-Refundable Rate) plans; true for flexible BAR (Best Available Rate) plans.
attributes.references: Oracle OPERA PMS; Sabre SynXis CRS; AHLA Consumer Protection Guidelines; GDPR Article 17

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this rate plan record was most recently updated in the source system. Used to detect changes for incremental ETL processing and audit compliance. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 5; SOX; USALI; Oracle OPERA PMS

attributes.name: loyalty_points_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether stays booked under this rate plan qualify for loyalty program points accrual. Wholesale, opaque, and certain promotional rates are typically ineligible for points earning.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM; Oracle OPERA PMS; AHLA Loyalty Program Standards

attributes.name: loyalty_tier_required
attributes.description: Minimum loyalty program membership tier required to access this rate plan. A value of 'none' indicates the rate is open to all guests regardless of loyalty status. Used to gate exclusive member rates.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM; Oracle OPERA PMS; AHLA Loyalty Program Standards

attributes.name: max_los
attributes.description: Maximum number of nights permitted under this rate plan. Used to prevent extended stays at promotional or deeply discounted rates. A null value indicates no maximum stay restriction.

attributes.name: meal_plan_type
attributes.description: Indicates the F&B (Food and Beverage) inclusions bundled with this rate plan. Room only includes no meals; bed and breakfast includes morning meal; half board includes breakfast and dinner; full board includes all three meals; all-inclusive covers meals, beverages, and selected activities.
attributes.references: Oracle OPERA PMS; IH&RA Meal Plan Standards; ISO 22000

attributes.name: min_los
attributes.description: Minimum number of nights a guest must book to qualify for this rate plan. A LOS (Length of Stay) restriction used in yield optimization to drive longer stays during high-demand periods. A value of 1 indicates no minimum stay restriction.
attributes.references: IDeaS G3 RMS; Infor EzRMS; AHLA Revenue Management Best Practices

attributes.name: ota_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether this rate plan is distributed through OTA (Online Travel Agency) channels such as Booking.com, Expedia, or Agoda. Controls rate visibility on third-party booking platforms.
attributes.references: Sabre SynXis CRS; HTNG Channel Distribution Standards; AHLA

attributes.name: rate_category
attributes.description: Secondary classification grouping rate plans by the market segment or distribution channel they serve. Public rates are available to all guests; negotiated rates are contracted with specific accounts; wholesale rates are sold through tour operators; group rates apply to block bookings; loyalty rates are exclusive to program members; employee rates are internal staff benefits.
attributes.references: IDeaS G3 RMS; Sabre SynXis CRS; STR STAR Report segmentation standards

attributes.name: rate_ceiling_amount
attributes.description: The maximum rate above which this rate plan cannot be sold, used to cap pricing during peak demand periods for contracted or promotional rates. Null indicates no ceiling constraint.
attributes.references: IDeaS G3 RMS; Infor EzRMS; USALI

attributes.name: rate_floor_amount
attributes.description: The minimum rate below which this rate plan cannot be sold, regardless of dynamic pricing adjustments. Protects rate integrity and brand positioning. Used by IDeaS G3 RMS as a hard constraint in yield optimization algorithms.
attributes.references: IDeaS G3 RMS; Infor EzRMS; USALI; AHLA Revenue Management Best Practices

attributes.name: rate_level
attributes.description: Indicates the organizational scope at which this rate plan is defined and managed. Property-level plans apply to a single hotel; brand-level plans apply across a brand portfolio; chain-level plans apply across the entire company; global plans may span international markets.
attributes.references: Sabre SynXis CRS; IDeaS G3 RMS; Oracle OPERA PMS

attributes.name: rate_plan_code
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric code uniquely identifying the rate plan across systems (e.g., BAR, CORP001, PKG-SPA). Used as the business key in IDeaS G3 RMS, Sabre SynXis CRS, and Oracle OPERA PMS for rate plan lookup and distribution. Satisfies MASTER_RESOURCE BUSINESS_IDENTIFIER category.
attributes.references: IDeaS G3 RMS; Sabre SynXis CRS; Oracle OPERA PMS; HTNG Rate Plan Standards

attributes.name: rate_plan_description
attributes.description: Free-text description of the rate plan's terms, inclusions, and conditions as displayed to guests and booking agents. Includes details on what is included in the rate, any special conditions, and marketing messaging.
attributes.references: Oracle OPERA PMS; Sabre SynXis CRS; AHLA Consumer Transparency Guidelines

attributes.name: rate_plan_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name of the rate plan displayed to guests and revenue managers (e.g., 'Best Available Rate', 'AAA Member Rate', 'Advance Purchase 21-Day'). Satisfies MASTER_RESOURCE IDENTITY_LABEL category.
attributes.references: IDeaS G3 RMS; Sabre SynXis CRS; Oracle OPERA PMS

attributes.name: rate_plan_type
attributes.description: Classification of the rate plan by its commercial structure. BAR (Best Available Rate) is the publicly available flexible rate; LRA (Last Room Availability) guarantees availability to contracted accounts; NRR (Non-Refundable Rate) carries no cancellation flexibility; corporate rates are negotiated with companies; package rates bundle room with ancillary services; promotional rates are time-limited offers. Satisfies MASTER_RESOURCE CLASSIFICATION_OR_TYPE category.
attributes.references: IDeaS G3 RMS; AHLA Rate Classification Standards; USALI

attributes.name: rate_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the rate plan. Active plans are available for booking; inactive plans are temporarily disabled; draft plans are under configuration; suspended plans are paused due to yield or compliance review; archived plans are retired and no longer bookable. Satisfies MASTER_RESOURCE LIFECYCLE_STATUS category.
attributes.references: IDeaS G3 RMS; Sabre SynXis CRS; Oracle OPERA PMS

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Identifies the operational system of record from which this rate plan record was sourced. Enables data lineage tracking and conflict resolution when the same rate plan exists in multiple systems.
attributes.references: IDeaS G3 RMS; Sabre SynXis CRS; Oracle OPERA PMS; Infor EzRMS; HTNG Data Exchange Standards

attributes.name: source_system_rate_reference
attributes.description: The native identifier of this rate plan in the originating operational system (IDeaS G3 RMS, Sabre SynXis CRS, or Oracle OPERA PMS). Enables bidirectional traceability between the lakehouse Silver layer and the system of record.
attributes.references: IDeaS G3 RMS; Sabre SynXis CRS; Oracle OPERA PMS; HTNG Data Exchange Standards

attributes.name: stay_date_restriction
attributes.description: Defines any day-of-week or date-specific restrictions on when stays under this rate plan are permitted. Weekday-only and weekend-only restrictions are common for corporate and leisure rates respectively; blackout dates exclude specific high-demand periods.
attributes.references: IDeaS G3 RMS; Oracle OPERA PMS; AHLA Revenue Management Best Practices

attributes.name: tax_inclusive
attributes.description: Indicates whether the base_rate_amount includes applicable taxes (VAT, occupancy tax, city tax). True for tax-inclusive markets; false for markets where taxes are added at checkout. Critical for accurate revenue recognition under USALI and IFRS/GAAP.
attributes.references: USALI; IFRS; GAAP; SAP S/4HANA; PCI DSS

products.name: rate_restriction
products.description: Operational records of rate restrictions applied to rate plans and room types, including minimum LOS (Length of Stay), maximum LOS, closed-to-arrival (CTA), closed-to-departure (CTD), advance purchase requirements, and blackout dates. Managed in IDeaS G3 RMS and distributed via Sabre SynXis CRS. Drives yield optimization by controlling which rates are bookable under specific conditions.

attributes.name: rate_restriction_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each rate restriction record in the revenue management system. Primary key for the rate_restriction data product in the Databricks Silver Layer.
attributes.references: IDeaS G3 RMS; Sabre SynXis CRS

attributes.name: allotment_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to inventory.allotment. Business justification: Allotment exhaustion or release triggers stop-sell and CTA rate restrictions for the associated channel/room_type. Linking rate_restriction to the allotment record allows channel managers to trace whi

attributes.name: cancellation_policy_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to reservation.cancellation_policy. Business justification: Revenue managers apply cancellation policy restrictions as part of yield management strategy. Rate restrictions must enforce specific cancellation terms (non-refundable, free cancellation windows) to

attributes.name: distribution_channel_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to channel.channel. Business justification: Restrictions (stop-sell, min LOS, CTA/CTD) are applied per distribution channel. Revenue managers close channels selectively based on demand - essential inventory control operation. Enables channel-sp

attributes.name: dynamic_rate_rule_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to revenue.dynamic_rate_rule. Business justification: Rate restrictions in IDeaS G3 RMS and Infor EzRMS are frequently triggered or recommended by Dynamic Rate Rules (DRRs). The rate_restriction table has an rms_recommendation_flag BOOLEAN indicating RMS

attributes.name: event_booking_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to event.event_booking. Business justification: Revenue managers apply specific rate restrictions (min LOS, CTA/CTD, hurdle rates) when large event bookings create displacement risk. Essential for RMS restriction management around group blocks and

attributes.name: group_block_id
attributes.description: Reference to the group block associated with this restriction, when the restriction is applied to protect inventory for a specific group booking or MICE event. Null for transient/individual restrictions.
attributes.references: Oracle OPERA PMS; Delphi by Amadeus; IDeaS G3 RMS

attributes.name: market_segment_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to revenue.market_segment. Business justification: Rate restrictions can be scoped to market segments (e.g., restrict Leisure segment on peak dates). rate_restriction has market_segment_code (STRING) which should be normalized to FK. N rate_restrictio

attributes.name: property_id
attributes.description: Reference to the property (hotel/resort) to which this rate restriction applies. Enables property-level yield optimization and restriction management across the portfolio.
attributes.references: Oracle OPERA PMS; IDeaS G3 RMS

attributes.name: revenue_rate_plan_id
attributes.description: Reference to the rate plan to which this restriction applies. Links to the rate plan master in the CRS/RMS (e.g., BAR, LRA, NRR, DRR). A restriction may apply to one or multiple rate plans; this field captures the primary rate plan association.
attributes.references: IDeaS G3 RMS; Sabre SynXis CRS; Oracle OPERA PMS

attributes.name: room_block_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to inventory.room_block. Business justification: Group room blocks routinely trigger rate restrictions (CTA, CTD, min-LOS) for the same date range. Revenue managers need to trace which inventory block drove a specific restriction for group contract

attributes.name: room_type_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific room type to which this restriction applies. When null, the restriction applies to all room types under the associated rate plan. Enables granular inventory control by room category.
attributes.references: Oracle OPERA PMS; IDeaS G3 RMS

attributes.name: seasonal_calendar_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to property.seasonal_calendar. Business justification: Rate restrictions are applied based on seasonal periods (min/max LOS, CTA, CTD). The rate_restriction has season_code as a denormalized string; a FK to seasonal_calendar formalizes the season-restrict

attributes.name: advance_purchase_days
attributes.description: Minimum number of days prior to arrival that a booking must be made to qualify for this rate plan. Supports NRR (Non-Refundable Rate) and advance purchase yield strategies. Null when restriction type is not ADVANCE_PURCHASE.
attributes.references: IDeaS G3 RMS; Sabre SynXis CRS; AHLA

attributes.name: applied_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this rate restriction was activated and distributed to connected channels (CRS, GDS, OTA). Represents the principal business event time — when the restriction became operationally effective in the distribution ecosystem. Formatted as yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.
attributes.references: IDeaS G3 RMS; Sabre SynXis CRS; HTNG

attributes.name: created_by_user
attributes.description: Username or employee identifier of the revenue manager or system process that created this rate restriction record. Supports SOX financial controls audit trail and accountability for yield management decisions.
attributes.references: SOX; IDeaS G3 RMS; Oracle OPERA PMS

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this rate restriction record was first created in the source system. Used for audit trail, data lineage, and SLA compliance tracking. Formatted as yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.
attributes.references: IDeaS G3 RMS; SOX; GDPR Article 5

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the hurdle_rate_amount and any monetary thresholds defined in this restriction (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP). Ensures consistent financial reporting per USALI standards.

attributes.name: days_of_week_mask
attributes.description: 7-character binary string indicating which days of the week the restriction applies, ordered Monday through Sunday (e.g., '1111100' = Mon–Fri only, '0000011' = Sat–Sun only). Enables day-of-week yield strategies such as weekend minimum stay requirements.

attributes.name: demand_forecast_level
attributes.description: Demand forecast classification at the time this restriction was created or last updated, as determined by the RMS (IDeaS G3 or Infor EzRMS). Provides context for why the restriction was applied and supports post-hoc yield strategy analysis.
attributes.references: IDeaS G3 RMS; Infor EzRMS; STR STAR Report

attributes.name: distribution_status
attributes.description: Indicates the current distribution state of this restriction across connected channels via Sabre SynXis CRS. 'pending' = queued for distribution; 'distributed' = successfully pushed to all channels; 'failed' = distribution error; 'partial' = distributed to some but not all channels.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: The calendar date from which this rate restriction becomes active and enforceable. Corresponds to the stay date (not booking date) unless the restriction type is ADVANCE_PURCHASE. Formatted as yyyy-MM-dd per model conventions.
attributes.references: IDeaS G3 RMS; Sabre SynXis CRS; AHLA

attributes.name: expiry_date
attributes.description: The last calendar date on which this rate restriction is enforceable (inclusive). Null indicates an open-ended restriction with no defined end. Formatted as yyyy-MM-dd per model conventions.
attributes.references: IDeaS G3 RMS; Sabre SynXis CRS

attributes.name: hurdle_rate_amount
attributes.description: Minimum acceptable rate (in the property's base currency) below which a booking will be rejected for this rate plan on the restricted date(s). A key RMS yield control used to protect ADR during high-demand periods. Null when restriction type is not HURDLE_RATE.
attributes.references: IDeaS G3 RMS; Infor EzRMS; USALI

attributes.name: is_blackout
attributes.description: Indicates whether the effective date range is designated as a blackout period, during which the rate plan is completely closed to new bookings. Commonly applied during peak demand events, holidays, or sold-out periods.
attributes.references: IDeaS G3 RMS; Sabre SynXis CRS; AHLA

attributes.name: is_cta
attributes.description: Indicates whether arrivals are blocked on the effective date(s) for this rate plan and room type. When True, guests cannot check in on the restricted date, preventing short-stay bookings that fragment inventory during high-demand periods.
attributes.references: IDeaS G3 RMS; Sabre SynXis CRS; HTNG

attributes.name: is_ctd
attributes.description: Indicates whether departures are blocked on the effective date(s) for this rate plan and room type. When True, guests cannot check out on the restricted date, used to extend stays through high-demand nights and maximize occupancy continuity.
attributes.references: IDeaS G3 RMS; Sabre SynXis CRS; HTNG

attributes.name: is_loyalty_exempt
attributes.description: Indicates whether members of the hotel's loyalty program are exempt from this restriction (e.g., LRA — Last Room Availability guarantee for elite members). Supports loyalty program administration and member benefit fulfillment.
attributes.references: Oracle OPERA PMS; Salesforce CRM; AHLA Loyalty Standards

attributes.name: last_distributed_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this restriction was last successfully distributed to external channels (OTA, GDS) via Sabre SynXis CRS. Used to monitor distribution latency and SLA compliance for rate parity management.

attributes.name: max_advance_purchase_days
attributes.description: Maximum number of days prior to arrival within which a booking must be made to qualify for this rate plan. Defines the booking window ceiling for advance purchase restrictions, preventing bookings made too far in advance at promotional rates.
attributes.references: IDeaS G3 RMS; Sabre SynXis CRS

attributes.name: max_los
attributes.description: Maximum number of nights a guest is permitted to stay under this rate plan on the restricted date(s). Used to prevent long-stay bookings at discounted rates during high-demand periods. Null when restriction type is not MAX_LOS.
attributes.references: IDeaS G3 RMS; Infor EzRMS; AHLA Revenue Management Standards

attributes.name: min_los
attributes.description: Minimum number of nights a guest must stay to be eligible to book under this rate plan on the restricted date(s). A core yield optimization lever in revenue management. Null when restriction type is not MIN_LOS.
attributes.references: IDeaS G3 RMS; Infor EzRMS; AHLA Revenue Management Standards

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional operational notes or context provided by the revenue manager regarding this restriction. May include references to specific events, competitive intelligence, or strategy rationale not captured in structured fields.
attributes.references: IDeaS G3 RMS; Oracle OPERA PMS

attributes.name: override_allowed
attributes.description: Indicates whether a revenue manager or front desk supervisor is permitted to manually override this restriction for individual bookings. When False, the restriction is hard-enforced and cannot be bypassed in the PMS or CRS.
attributes.references: Oracle OPERA PMS; IDeaS G3 RMS

attributes.name: override_authorization_level
attributes.description: Minimum staff authorization level required to override this restriction when override_allowed is True. Ensures appropriate governance over yield control exceptions. Null when override_allowed is False.
attributes.references: Oracle OPERA PMS; IDeaS G3 RMS; SOX

attributes.name: priority_rank
attributes.description: Numeric priority rank used to resolve conflicts when multiple restrictions apply to the same rate plan, room type, and date. Lower values indicate higher priority. Ensures deterministic restriction enforcement when overlapping rules exist in the RMS.
attributes.references: IDeaS G3 RMS; Sabre SynXis CRS

attributes.name: restriction_code
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric code uniquely identifying this rate restriction rule as defined in IDeaS G3 RMS or Sabre SynXis CRS. Used for cross-system reconciliation and distribution to OTA and GDS channels.
attributes.references: IDeaS G3 RMS; Sabre SynXis CRS; HTNG

attributes.name: restriction_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name describing the rate restriction rule (e.g., 'Weekend Min 2-Night Stay', 'Holiday CTA Block'). Used by revenue managers and front desk staff to identify restrictions in PMS and RMS interfaces.
attributes.references: IDeaS G3 RMS; Oracle OPERA PMS

attributes.name: restriction_reason
attributes.description: Free-text or coded explanation for why this restriction was applied (e.g., 'Peak demand event', 'Holiday blackout', 'Group block protection', 'RMS auto-recommendation'). Supports revenue strategy documentation and post-stay performance analysis.
attributes.references: IDeaS G3 RMS; Infor EzRMS; AHLA

attributes.name: restriction_scope
attributes.description: Defines the level at which this restriction is applied: 'property' = entire property; 'room_type' = specific room category; 'rate_plan' = specific rate plan only; 'channel' = specific distribution channel (OTA, GDS, direct). Determines how broadly the restriction is enforced across inventory.
attributes.references: IDeaS G3 RMS; Sabre SynXis CRS; HTNG

attributes.name: restriction_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the rate restriction record. 'active' = currently enforced; 'inactive' = disabled but retained for history; 'pending' = scheduled but not yet effective; 'expired' = past end date; 'overridden' = manually superseded by a revenue manager.
attributes.references: IDeaS G3 RMS; Sabre SynXis CRS

attributes.name: restriction_type
attributes.description: Classification of the restriction mechanism applied. MIN_LOS = Minimum Length of Stay; MAX_LOS = Maximum Length of Stay; CTA = Closed to Arrival; CTD = Closed to Departure; ADVANCE_PURCHASE = minimum days before arrival required to book; BLACKOUT = date fully closed to booking; HURDLE_RATE = minimum acceptable rate threshold. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: MIN_LOS|MAX_LOS|CTA|CTD|ADVANCE_PURCHASE|BLACKOUT|HURDLE_RATE — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: IDeaS G3 RMS; Infor EzRMS; AHLA Revenue Management Standards

attributes.name: rms_recommendation_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this restriction was system-recommended by the RMS (True) or manually created by a revenue manager (False). Enables analysis of RMS automation adoption rates and comparison of system vs. human yield decisions.

attributes.name: source_system_restriction_reference
attributes.description: The native identifier of this restriction record in the originating operational system (IDeaS G3 RMS, Sabre SynXis CRS, etc.). Enables traceability and reconciliation between the lakehouse Silver Layer and the system of record.
attributes.references: IDeaS G3 RMS; Sabre SynXis CRS; HTNG

attributes.name: updated_by_user
attributes.description: Username or employee identifier of the revenue manager or system process that last modified this rate restriction record. Supports audit trail and governance of yield management changes.
attributes.references: SOX; IDeaS G3 RMS; Oracle OPERA PMS

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this rate restriction record was last modified in the source system. Tracks the most recent change for audit and reconciliation purposes. Formatted as yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.
attributes.references: IDeaS G3 RMS; SOX; GDPR Article 5

products.name: dynamic_rate_rule
products.description: DRR (Dynamic Rate Rule) definitions governing automated pricing adjustments in IDeaS G3 RMS and Infor EzRMS. Captures rule type (occupancy-based, pickup-based, competitive-based, event-based), trigger thresholds, adjustment type (percentage, absolute, BAR offset), applicable room types, applicable rate plans, effective date ranges, and rule priority. Core mechanism for yield optimization and dynamic pricing strategy.

attributes.name: dynamic_rate_rule_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for a Dynamic Rate Rule (DRR) record in the revenue management system. Primary key for this entity.

attributes.name: demand_forecast_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the demand forecast record from IDeaS G3 RMS or Infor EzRMS that this forecast-based Dynamic Rate Rule references for its trigger evaluation.

attributes.description: Foreign key linking to channel.channel. Business justification: Dynamic pricing rules target specific channels differently (e.g., OTA rates adjust based on commission costs, direct channel gets best rate). RMS systems apply channel-specific rate optimization strat

attributes.description: Foreign key linking to fnb.fnb_outlet. Business justification: Dynamic pricing rules monitor outlet occupancy for total revenue optimization (restaurant full = adjust room+dining packages). Required for integrated revenue management systems that optimize property

attributes.business_glossary_term: Monitored Fnb Revenue Center Id (Foreign Key)
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to fnb.revenue_center. Business justification: RMS dynamic pricing: revenue managers configure rules that trigger room rate adjustments based on F&B revenue center performance (e.g., banquet bookings driving demand). Existing FK covers outlet moni

attributes.name: property_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the hotel or resort property to which this Dynamic Rate Rule applies. Links to the property master record in Oracle OPERA PMS.
attributes.references: Oracle OPERA PMS; IDeaS G3 RMS

attributes.name: revenue_rate_plan_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the rate plan (e.g., BAR, LRA, NRR) to which this Dynamic Rate Rule applies. A null value indicates the rule applies across all eligible rate plans for the property.
attributes.references: Oracle OPERA PMS; Sabre SynXis CRS; IDeaS G3 RMS

attributes.name: room_type_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the specific room type (e.g., standard king, deluxe suite) to which this Dynamic Rate Rule applies. A null value indicates the rule applies across all room types at the property.
attributes.references: Oracle OPERA PMS; IDeaS G3 RMS

attributes.name: adjustment_direction
attributes.description: Indicates whether the Dynamic Rate Rule increases or decreases the rate when triggered. Provides explicit directional intent separate from the sign of adjustment_value to prevent ambiguity in RMS configuration.

attributes.name: adjustment_type
attributes.description: Method by which the Dynamic Rate Rule adjusts the published rate when triggered. Percentage applies a relative increase or decrease to the current rate; absolute_amount adds or subtracts a fixed currency value; bar_offset moves the rate a fixed amount above or below the Best Available Rate (BAR); bar_multiplier applies a multiplier to the BAR.
attributes.references: IDeaS G3 RMS; Infor EzRMS; Oracle OPERA PMS

attributes.name: adjustment_value
attributes.description: The magnitude of the rate adjustment applied when the Dynamic Rate Rule is triggered. Interpreted according to adjustment_type: a value of 0.10 with type 'percentage' means a 10% rate increase; a value of 25.00 with type 'absolute_amount' means a $25 rate increase; a value of -15.00 with type 'bar_offset' means $15 below BAR.

attributes.name: advance_booking_max_days
attributes.description: Maximum number of days in advance of the arrival date within which a booking must be made for this Dynamic Rate Rule to be eligible to apply. Null indicates no upper advance booking restriction.
attributes.references: IDeaS G3 RMS; Infor EzRMS; Sabre SynXis CRS

attributes.name: advance_booking_min_days
attributes.description: Minimum number of days in advance of the arrival date that a booking must be made for this Dynamic Rate Rule to be eligible to apply. Supports advance purchase pricing strategies.
attributes.references: IDeaS G3 RMS; Infor EzRMS; Sabre SynXis CRS

attributes.name: approval_status
attributes.description: Workflow approval state of the Dynamic Rate Rule indicating whether it has been reviewed and authorized by a revenue manager before activation. Supports SOX-compliant pricing governance controls.

attributes.name: approved_by
attributes.description: Name or employee identifier of the revenue manager or director who approved this Dynamic Rate Rule for activation. Required for SOX financial controls audit trail on pricing decisions.

attributes.name: approved_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this Dynamic Rate Rule was approved for activation by the authorized revenue manager. Part of the pricing governance audit trail required under SOX financial controls.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this Dynamic Rate Rule record was first created in the system. Part of the standard audit trail for pricing configuration governance.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the property in which rate floor, ceiling, and absolute adjustment values are denominated (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP).

attributes.name: days_of_week_mask
attributes.description: Seven-character binary string (positions 1–7 = Mon–Sun) indicating which days of the week this Dynamic Rate Rule is eligible to fire. A value of '1111100' means Monday through Friday only. Enables day-of-week yield optimization strategies.

attributes.name: effective_from
attributes.description: The calendar date from which this Dynamic Rate Rule becomes active and eligible to trigger automated pricing adjustments in the RMS. Aligns with the stay date range for yield optimization.
attributes.references: IDeaS G3 RMS; Infor EzRMS; USALI

attributes.name: effective_until
attributes.description: The calendar date on which this Dynamic Rate Rule expires and ceases to trigger automated pricing adjustments. Null indicates an open-ended rule with no defined expiry.
attributes.references: IDeaS G3 RMS; Infor EzRMS; USALI

attributes.name: is_stackable
attributes.description: Indicates whether this Dynamic Rate Rule can be combined (stacked) with other active rules for the same stay date, room type, and rate plan. When False, this rule takes exclusive precedence based on rule_priority and no other rules are applied concurrently.

attributes.name: last_triggered_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this Dynamic Rate Rule was most recently evaluated as true and triggered an automated pricing adjustment in the RMS. Used by revenue managers to monitor rule activity and effectiveness.

attributes.name: los_max_nights
attributes.description: Maximum Length of Stay (LOS) restriction in nights beyond which this Dynamic Rate Rule does not apply. Null indicates no upper LOS restriction.
attributes.references: IDeaS G3 RMS; Infor EzRMS; Oracle OPERA PMS

attributes.name: los_min_nights
attributes.description: Minimum Length of Stay (LOS) restriction in nights that must be satisfied for this Dynamic Rate Rule to apply. Used in LOS-based yield optimization to drive longer stays during high-demand periods.
attributes.references: IDeaS G3 RMS; Infor EzRMS; Oracle OPERA PMS

attributes.name: max_rate_ceiling
attributes.description: The highest permissible rate (in property currency) that this Dynamic Rate Rule may produce after adjustment. Acts as a pricing guardrail to prevent rates from exceeding the property's maximum acceptable rate cap. Sensitive pricing strategy data.
attributes.references: IDeaS G3 RMS; Infor EzRMS; USALI; AHLA

attributes.name: min_rate_floor
attributes.description: The lowest permissible rate (in property currency) that this Dynamic Rate Rule may produce after adjustment. Acts as a pricing guardrail to prevent rates from falling below the property's minimum acceptable ADR threshold. Sensitive pricing strategy data.
attributes.references: IDeaS G3 RMS; Infor EzRMS; USALI; AHLA

attributes.name: pickup_window_days
attributes.description: Number of days in the booking pickup window used to evaluate pickup velocity for pickup-based Dynamic Rate Rules. For example, a value of 7 means the rule evaluates rooms booked in the last 7 days.

attributes.name: rms_rule_reference_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: Revenue Management System (RMS) Rule Reference ID
attributes.description: Native rule identifier assigned by the source Revenue Management System (IDeaS G3 RMS or Infor EzRMS) for this Dynamic Rate Rule. Used for system-of-record traceability and reconciliation between the lakehouse Silver layer and the operational RMS.
