attributes.name: bonus_points_on_enrollment
attributes.description: Number of bonus loyalty points awarded to a member upon first achieving this tier status.

attributes.name: breakfast_benefit_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether members at this tier receive complimentary breakfast during their stays.

attributes.name: code
attributes.description: Short alphanumeric code uniquely identifying the tier (e.g., SILVER, GOLD, PLATINUM, DIAMOND). Used for system integration and display.

attributes.name: color_code
attributes.description: Hexadecimal color code used for visual representation of the tier in digital interfaces and marketing materials (e.g., #C0C0C0 for Silver, #FFD700 for Gold).

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this tier record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: dedicated_support_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether members at this tier have access to a dedicated customer service line or concierge team.

attributes.name: description
attributes.description: Detailed description of the tier, including benefits summary and value proposition, used for member communications and marketing.

attributes.name: display_order
attributes.description: Numeric sort order for displaying tiers in user interfaces and reports. Lower numbers appear first.

attributes.name: downgrade_grace_period_months
attributes.description: Number of months of grace period provided before downgrading a member who no longer meets qualification thresholds.

attributes.name: early_checkin_hours
attributes.description: Number of hours before standard check-in time that members at this tier are entitled to for early check-in (e.g., 2 for 1pm check-in when standard is 3pm).

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: Date when this tier definition expires or was discontinued. Null for currently active tiers with no planned end date.

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: Date when this tier definition became or will become active and available for member assignment.

attributes.name: guaranteed_availability_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether members at this tier have guaranteed room availability when booking within specified advance notice periods.

attributes.name: icon_url
attributes.description: URL or path to the icon or badge image representing this tier in digital channels.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this tier record was last updated.

attributes.name: late_checkout_hours
attributes.description: Number of hours past standard checkout time that members at this tier are entitled to for late checkout (e.g., 2 for 2pm checkout when standard is 12pm).

attributes.name: level
attributes.description: Numeric ranking of the tier within the program hierarchy. Lower numbers indicate entry-level tiers, higher numbers indicate elite status. Used for tier comparison and upgrade logic.

attributes.name: lounge_access_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether members at this tier have complimentary access to executive lounges or club floors at participating properties.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Full display name of the loyalty tier (e.g., Silver Elite, Gold Premier, Platinum Honors, Diamond Ambassador).

attributes.name: points_earning_multiplier
attributes.description: Multiplier applied to base points earning for members at this tier (e.g., 1.5 means 50% bonus points, 2.0 means double points).

attributes.name: priority_reservation_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether members at this tier receive priority handling for reservations and waitlist requests.

attributes.name: qualification_nights_threshold
attributes.description: Minimum number of qualifying nights required to achieve or maintain this tier status within the qualification period.

attributes.name: qualification_period_months
attributes.description: Number of months over which qualification activity is measured (e.g., 12 for annual qualification, 24 for rolling two-year window).

attributes.name: qualification_points_threshold
attributes.description: Minimum number of loyalty points required to achieve or maintain this tier status within the qualification period.

attributes.name: qualification_spend_threshold
attributes.description: Minimum monetary spend amount required to achieve or maintain this tier status within the qualification period. Typically measured in the program's base currency.

attributes.name: qualification_stays_threshold
attributes.description: Minimum number of qualifying stays required to achieve or maintain this tier status within the qualification period.

attributes.name: room_upgrade_eligible_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether members at this tier are eligible for complimentary room upgrades at check-in (subject to availability).

attributes.name: tier_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the tier. Active tiers are available for member assignment; inactive tiers are temporarily suspended; discontinued tiers are retired but may have legacy members.

attributes.name: validity_months
attributes.description: Number of months that tier status remains valid once achieved, before re-qualification is required (e.g., 12 for annual renewal, 24 for two-year validity).

attributes.name: welcome_amenity_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether members at this tier receive a welcome amenity (e.g., fruit basket, beverage credit) upon arrival.

products.name: points_ledger
products.description: Authoritative transactional ledger recording every points movement for a loyalty member — including accruals, redemptions, expirations, adjustments, and partner transfers. Each row is an immutable debit or credit entry capturing transaction type (earn, redeem, expire, adjust, transfer_out, transfer_in, bonus), points amount, balance after transaction, source activity (stay, F&B spend, partner purchase, promotion), activity date, posting date, expiry date, originating system reference. For transfer-type entries: partner program reference, transfer direction, conversion rate applied, partner confirmation number, transfer status, and fee charged. This is the SSOT for points balance, movement history, and partner transfer activity.

attributes.name: points_ledger_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for each points ledger transaction entry. Primary key for the points ledger.

attributes.name: reversal_reference_points_ledger_id
attributes.description: Points ledger ID of the original transaction that this entry reverses. Null for original transactions. Creates audit trail for cancelled transactions.

attributes.description: Date when the underlying business activity occurred (e.g., stay checkout date, F&B transaction date, partner purchase date). This is the business event date, distinct from posting date.

attributes.name: adjustment_notes
attributes.description: Free-text explanation for manual adjustments or reversals, providing context for audit and member service. Null for standard transactions.

attributes.name: adjustment_reason_code
attributes.description: Standardized code explaining why a manual adjustment or reversal was made (e.g., service recovery, system error correction, duplicate posting). Null for standard transactions.

attributes.name: balance_after_transaction
attributes.description: Member's total points balance immediately after this transaction was posted. Provides running balance for audit and reconciliation.

attributes.name: base_amount
attributes.description: Monetary amount in base currency that generated the points accrual (e.g., room revenue, F&B spend). Used to calculate points earned. Null for non-monetary transactions.
attributes.references: USALI - Uniform System of Accounts for the Lodging Industry

attributes.name: conversion_rate
attributes.description: Exchange rate applied when converting points between hotel program and partner program (e.g., 1.5 means 1 hotel point = 1.5 partner points). Null for non-transfer transactions.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp when this ledger entry was first created in the database. Used for audit trail and data lineage.

attributes.name: expiry_date
attributes.description: Date when these points will expire if not redeemed. Null for non-expiring points or debit transactions. Used to enforce points expiration policies.

attributes.name: is_qualifying
attributes.description: Indicates whether this transaction counts toward tier qualification or elite status progression. True for qualifying stays and spend, false for bonus points and transfers.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp when this ledger entry was last updated. Used for audit trail and change tracking.

attributes.name: partner_confirmation_number
attributes.description: Confirmation or reference number provided by partner program for transfer transactions. Used for reconciliation and dispute resolution. Null for non-transfer transactions.

attributes.name: partner_program_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the external partner loyalty program involved in transfer transactions (e.g., airline frequent flyer program, credit card rewards program). Null for internal transactions.

attributes.name: points_amount
attributes.description: Quantity of points involved in this transaction. Positive for accruals (earn, transfer_in, bonus), negative for debits (redeem, transfer_out, expire, adjust).

attributes.name: posting_date
attributes.description: Date when the points transaction was posted to the member's account and became effective in their balance. May differ from activity_date due to processing lag.

attributes.name: source_activity_type

attributes.description: Member's loyalty tier status at the time this transaction was posted (e.g., Silver, Gold, Platinum). Captures tier for historical analysis of earning patterns.

attributes.name: transaction_number
attributes.description: Business-facing unique identifier for this points transaction, used for member inquiries and reconciliation.

attributes.name: transaction_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the points transaction: pending (awaiting posting), posted (finalized and reflected in balance), reversed (cancelled), failed (rejected due to validation error).

attributes.name: transaction_type
attributes.description: Type of points movement: earn (accrual from activity), redeem (points spent), expire (time-based expiration), adjust (manual correction), transfer_out (sent to partner), transfer_in (received from partner), bonus (promotional award), reversal (cancellation of prior transaction). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: earn|redeem|expire|adjust|transfer_out|transfer_in|bonus|reversal — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: transfer_direction
attributes.description: Direction of partner transfer: inbound (points received from partner into hotel program), outbound (points sent from hotel program to partner). Null for non-transfer transactions.

attributes.name: transfer_fee_amount
attributes.description: Fee charged to member for partner transfer transaction, expressed in points. Null if no fee applies or for non-transfer transactions.

products.name: accrual_rule
products.description: Master configuration entity defining the rules by which loyalty points are earned. Captures rule name, earning basis (room revenue, F&B spend, spa spend, partner spend), points-per-currency-unit rate, multiplier for tier or segment, eligible rate codes, blackout conditions, effective date range, property applicability, and rule priority. Drives the points calculation engine for all earn transactions.

attributes.name: accrual_rule_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the loyalty points accrual rule. Primary key for the accrual rule configuration entity.

attributes.name: channel_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to channel.channel. Business justification: Accrual rules are scoped to specific distribution channels (direct=3x, GDS=1x, OTA=1x). Loyalty operations teams configure channel-specific earning multipliers. The existing 'booking_channel_restricti

attributes.name: currency_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to property.currency. Business justification: Accrual rule currency normalization: accrual_rule.currency_code governs points_per_currency_unit and minimum_transaction_amount calculations. FK to currency enables proper multi-currency earning rate

attributes.name: hierarchy_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to property.hierarchy. Business justification: Loyalty operations: accrual rules are scoped to brand portfolios, geographic regions, or management groups — all modeled as hierarchy nodes. FK to hierarchy replaces denormalized applicable_regions/ap

attributes.description: Foreign key linking to revenue.market_segment. Business justification: Accrual rules are frequently segment-restricted (e.g., corporate segment earns 3x points, leisure earns 1x). The existing member_segment_restriction is a denormalized text field. A proper FK to market

attributes.name: property_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to property.property. Business justification: Property revenue managers need to forecast loyalty liability by analyzing which accrual rules apply to their property. Currently applicable_property_ids is a text list; FK enables property-specific ea

attributes.name: property_outlet_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to property.property_outlet. Business justification: Outlet-specific earning rules: hotel loyalty programs configure bonus point multipliers for specific F&B outlets (e.g., 3x points at the signature restaurant). FK to property_outlet enables outlet-lev

attributes.name: room_type_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to inventory.room_type. Business justification: Accrual rules are applied per room type (e.g., 3x points for Suite bookings, bonus multiplier for premium room categories). Points posting engines require accrual_rule.room_type_id to match the booked

attributes.name: segment_id

attributes.name: tier_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to loyalty.tier. Business justification: Accrual rules are frequently tier-specific — e.g., Gold members earn 3x points under a particular rule. The existing member_tier_restriction column is a denormalized STRING that should be replaced by

attributes.name: applicable_property_ids
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of property identifiers where this rule applies. Used when property_applicability is 'property_list'. Null indicates rule applies per property_applicability setting.

attributes.name: approval_status
attributes.description: Workflow approval status for the accrual rule configuration. Used for governance and change control before rules are activated in production.

attributes.name: approved_by
attributes.description: User ID or name of the business owner or system administrator who approved this accrual rule for production use. Used for audit trail and accountability.

attributes.name: approved_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this accrual rule was approved for production use. Part of the governance audit trail.

attributes.name: blackout_dates
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of date ranges (YYYY-MM-DD:YYYY-MM-DD) during which this accrual rule does not apply. Used for promotional exclusions or high-demand periods. Null indicates no blackouts.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this accrual rule record was first created in the system. Part of the standard audit trail.

attributes.name: day_of_week_restriction
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of days of week (MON, TUE, WED, THU, FRI, SAT, SUN) when this rule applies. Used for promotional rules targeting specific days. Null indicates all days are eligible.

attributes.name: earning_basis
attributes.description: The transaction component or activity on which points accrual is calculated: room_revenue (ADR-based), fnb_spend (Food and Beverage), spa_spend, ancillary_spend (parking, resort fees), partner_spend (co-branded partners), nights_stayed (per-night basis), qualifying_stays (per-stay basis). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: room_revenue|fnb_spend|spa_spend|ancillary_spend|partner_spend|nights_stayed|qualifying_stays — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: Date when this accrual rule expires and stops applying to transactions. Null indicates the rule is open-ended with no expiration. Part of the rule's temporal validity window.

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: Date when this accrual rule becomes active and begins applying to qualifying transactions. Part of the rule's temporal validity window.

attributes.name: eligible_rate_codes
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of rate codes (BAR, corporate, government, promotional) that qualify for points earning under this rule. Null or empty indicates all rate codes are eligible.

attributes.name: estimated_annual_points_volume
attributes.description: Projected total number of loyalty points expected to be issued annually under this accrual rule. Used for program economics forecasting and liability planning.

attributes.name: excluded_rate_codes
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of rate codes explicitly excluded from earning points under this rule (e.g., employee rates, complimentary stays, distressed inventory). Takes precedence over eligible_rate_codes.

attributes.name: external_rule_code
attributes.description: Unique identifier for this accrual rule in the source operational system. Used for cross-system reconciliation and integration mapping.

attributes.name: is_stackable
attributes.description: Indicates whether this accrual rule can be combined with other rules for the same transaction (True) or is mutually exclusive (False). Used to control promotional stacking and program economics.

attributes.name: last_modified_by
attributes.description: User ID or name of the person who last modified this accrual rule configuration. Used for audit trail and change tracking.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this accrual rule record was last updated. Part of the standard audit trail for configuration change management.

attributes.name: marketing_message
attributes.description: Member-facing promotional message describing the earning opportunity (e.g., 'Earn 2X points on weekend stays!'). Used in marketing campaigns and member communications.

attributes.name: maximum_points_per_transaction
attributes.description: Cap on the number of points that can be earned in a single transaction under this rule. Used to prevent abuse and manage program liability. Null indicates no cap.

attributes.name: minimum_transaction_amount
attributes.description: Minimum spend threshold required for the accrual rule to apply. Transactions below this amount do not earn points under this rule. Null indicates no minimum.

attributes.name: points_per_currency_unit
attributes.description: Base rate of loyalty points earned per unit of currency spent (e.g., 10.0000 points per USD, 5.0000 points per EUR). Used as the multiplier in the points calculation engine.

attributes.name: program_liability_impact
attributes.description: Assessment of the financial liability impact this accrual rule has on the loyalty program's balance sheet: low (minimal incremental liability), medium (moderate impact), high (significant liability increase). Used for program economics monitoring.

attributes.name: property_applicability
attributes.description: Scope of properties where this accrual rule applies: all (entire portfolio), brand_specific (luxury/premium/select-service), property_list (specific property IDs), region_specific (geographic regions).

attributes.name: rule_code
attributes.description: Short alphanumeric code used as a unique business identifier for the accrual rule in operational systems and reporting (e.g., 'ROOM_BASE', 'FNB_ELITE', 'SPA_PROMO').

attributes.name: rule_description
attributes.description: Detailed business description of the accrual rule, including its purpose, earning mechanics, eligibility criteria, and any special conditions. Used for documentation and business user reference.

attributes.name: rule_name
attributes.description: Business-friendly name of the accrual rule for identification and reporting purposes (e.g., 'Base Room Revenue Earn', 'Elite Tier Bonus', 'F&B Spend Multiplier').

attributes.name: rule_priority
attributes.description: Numeric priority ranking used to resolve conflicts when multiple accrual rules apply to the same transaction. Lower numbers indicate higher priority. The points calculation engine applies the highest-priority matching rule.

attributes.name: rule_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the accrual rule: draft (under development), active (in production), suspended (temporarily disabled), expired (past effective_end_date), retired (permanently deactivated).

attributes.name: rule_type

attributes.name: member_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to loyalty.member_segment. Business justification: promotion has target_segment (STRING) describing which member segment the promotion targets. Adding member_segment_id FK formalizes this relationship, enabling segment-level promotion management and t

attributes.name: property_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to property.property. Business justification: Property marketing teams analyze which promotions drive enrollment and stays at their property for campaign ROI measurement. Currently qualifying_property_list is text; FK enables property-level promo

attributes.name: qualifying_revenue_rate_plan_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Qualifying Revenue Rate Plan Id (Foreign Key)
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to revenue.revenue_rate_plan. Business justification: Loyalty promotions require guests to book specific rate plans to qualify (e.g., 'Book Rate X, earn 2x points'). Promotion eligibility validation during booking is a core loyalty-revenue integration pr

tag_set.value: Qualifying Revenue Rate Plan Id (Foreign Key)

attributes.name: reward_catalog_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to loyalty.reward_catalog. Business justification: A promotion may award a specific reward from the reward catalog (e.g., a 'Stay 3 nights, earn a free night' promotion references a specific free-night reward in the catalog). Adding reward_catalog_id

attributes.name: room_type_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to inventory.room_type. Business justification: Loyalty promotions are frequently room-type-specific (e.g., 'Double points on Suite stays', 'Bonus nights for Deluxe bookings'). Marketing and revenue teams need promotion.room_type_id to enforce elig

attributes.name: segment_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to guest.segment. Business justification: Loyalty promotions are routinely targeted at specific guest market segments (e.g., 'Double points for Leisure segment'). A direct FK enables segment-targeted promotion configuration, campaign eligibil

attributes.name: tier_id
attributes.description: Reference to the loyalty tier required to participate in this promotion. Null if promotion is open to all tiers. Used to restrict offers to specific membership levels (e.g., Gold, Platinum, Diamond).

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: Date when this promotion was formally approved for launch. Null if promotion is still in draft or pending approval. Used for campaign governance and audit trail.

attributes.name: approved_by
attributes.description: Username or employee ID of the manager or director who approved this promotion for launch. Null if promotion is still in draft status. Used for governance and approval workflow tracking.

attributes.name: award_fulfillment_date
attributes.description: Target date by which bonus points or nights will be posted to qualifying members' accounts after promotion completion. Used for member communication and fulfillment SLA (Service Level Agreement) tracking.

attributes.name: bonus_nights_credit
attributes.description: Number of bonus elite-qualifying nights awarded upon promotion completion. Used for tier progression acceleration. Null if promotion does not award night credits.

attributes.name: bonus_points_amount
attributes.description: Fixed number of bonus loyalty points awarded upon successful completion of promotion criteria. Null if bonus is not a fixed point amount (e.g., multiplier-based).

attributes.name: bonus_points_multiplier
attributes.description: Multiplier applied to base points earned during the promotion period. Example: 2.0 for double points, 1.5 for 50% bonus. Null if promotion awards fixed points rather than a multiplier.

attributes.name: budget_cap_amount
attributes.description: Maximum financial budget allocated for this promotion (total cost of all bonuses awarded). Promotion may be paused or closed early if budget is exhausted. Measured in base currency (typically USD).

attributes.name: budget_consumed_amount
attributes.description: Cumulative financial cost of bonuses awarded to date under this promotion. Updated as members complete qualifying activity and bonuses are posted. Used for budget tracking and ROI (Return on Investment) analysis.

attributes.name: cancellation_reason
attributes.description: Explanation for why the promotion was cancelled or terminated early. Null if promotion completed normally or is still active. Examples: 'Budget exhausted', 'Low engagement', 'Business priority change', 'Legal compliance issue'.

attributes.name: code
attributes.description: Externally-known unique alphanumeric code for the promotion, used in marketing materials and member enrollment. Example: BONUS2024, WELCOME500.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this promotion record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage.

attributes.name: end_date
attributes.description: Date when the promotion expires. Qualifying activity after this date does not count toward the promotion. Null for open-ended promotions.

attributes.name: exclusion_list
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of member IDs or segments explicitly excluded from this promotion (e.g., employees, test accounts, members who opted out). Null if no exclusions apply.

attributes.name: minimum_nights
attributes.description: Minimum number of qualifying nights required to earn the promotion bonus. Null if nights are not a qualifying criterion.

attributes.name: minimum_spend_amount
attributes.description: Minimum total spend (in base currency) required to qualify for the promotion. Null if spend is not a qualifying criterion. Typically measured in USD or property local currency.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Human-readable name of the promotion displayed to members and in marketing channels. Example: 'Double Points Summer Getaway', 'Elite Status Fast Track'.

attributes.name: promotion_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the promotion. Values: draft (being designed), scheduled (approved, not yet live), active (currently running), paused (temporarily suspended), completed (ended successfully), cancelled (terminated early).

attributes.name: promotion_type
attributes.description: Classification of the promotion mechanism. Values: bonus_points_multiplier (earn extra points per dollar), double_nights (accelerate tier qualification), targeted_offer (personalized to segment), welcome_back (re-engagement), birthday_bonus (member birthday reward), spend_challenge (gamified spending goal).

attributes.name: qualifying_criteria_description
attributes.description: Detailed narrative of the requirements a member must meet to earn the promotion bonus. Examples: 'Complete 3 stays between June 1 and August 31', 'Spend minimum $500 on F&B (Food and Beverage) during stay', 'Book via mobile app using rate code MOBILE2024'.

attributes.name: qualifying_rate_codes
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of rate codes (BAR - Best Available Rate, corporate codes, promotional codes) that qualify for this promotion. Null or 'ALL' if all rate codes qualify. Example: 'BAR,CORP,PROMO2024'.

attributes.name: registration_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether members must explicitly register or opt-in to participate in this promotion. True = registration required before qualifying activity counts; False = automatic enrollment for eligible members.

attributes.name: stackable_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this promotion can be combined with other active promotions. True = member can earn bonuses from multiple promotions simultaneously; False = this promotion cannot be stacked with others.

attributes.name: start_date
attributes.description: Date when the promotion becomes active and members can begin earning toward the bonus. Qualifying activity before this date does not count.

attributes.name: terms_and_conditions_url
attributes.description: Web link to the full legal terms and conditions document for this promotion. Displayed to members during enrollment and in promotional materials.

attributes.name: total_completions
attributes.description: Count of members who have successfully completed all qualifying criteria and earned the promotion bonus. Used for conversion rate and campaign effectiveness analysis.

attributes.name: total_enrollments
attributes.description: Count of unique members who have enrolled or been auto-enrolled in this promotion. Used for campaign reach and engagement metrics.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this promotion record was last modified. Updated whenever any attribute changes. Used for change tracking and audit trail.

attributes.name: created_by
attributes.description: Username or employee ID of the marketing or loyalty team member who created this promotion record. Used for audit trail and accountability.

products.name: member_preference
products.description: Master record of a loyalty member's stated and inferred preferences used to personalize the hospitality experience. Captures preference category (room type, pillow type, floor preference, amenity preferences, dietary restrictions, communication channel, language, newspaper, housekeeping schedule), preference source (stated at enrollment, updated via app, inferred from stay history), confidence level, and last updated date. Distinct from guest domain preferences as this is loyalty-program-managed personalization data.
products.reference: Member Preference Profile / Guest Preference Record

attributes.name: member_preference_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the member preference record. Primary key.

attributes.name: member_id
attributes.description: Reference to the loyalty member who holds this preference. Links to the loyalty member master record.

attributes.name: property_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to property.property. Business justification: Property guest services teams honor member preferences (e.g., 'never book me at this property', 'preferred property for business travel') during reservation and check-in. Currently restricted_property

attributes.name: brand_restriction
attributes.description: The brand code if this preference is restricted to a specific brand within the portfolio. Nullable if preference applies across all brands.

attributes.name: confidence_level
attributes.description: The confidence or reliability level of this preference. Stated preferences have highest confidence; inferred preferences are scored based on frequency and recency of observed behavior.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this preference record was first created in the loyalty system. Audit trail for record creation.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: The date from which this preference becomes active and should be applied to member experiences.
attributes.references: USALI (Uniform System of Accounts for the Lodging Industry)

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: The date after which this preference is no longer valid or should no longer be applied. Nullable for preferences with no expiration.
attributes.references: USALI (Uniform System of Accounts for the Lodging Industry)

attributes.name: last_confirmed_date
attributes.description: The date when the member explicitly confirmed or reaffirmed this preference. Distinct from last_updated_date which may include system-inferred updates.

attributes.name: last_observed_date
attributes.description: The most recent date when this preference was observed in a stay or interaction. Used for recency scoring in confidence calculations.

attributes.name: last_updated_date
attributes.description: The date when this preference was last modified or confirmed by the member or system. Used to track recency for confidence scoring.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes or additional context about this preference. May include special instructions, member comments, or operational guidance.

attributes.name: observation_count
attributes.description: The number of times this preference has been observed in the member's stay history or interactions. Used to calculate confidence level for inferred preferences.

attributes.name: override_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this preference can be overridden by operational constraints or property-level decisions. True if override is allowed; false if preference must be honored.

attributes.name: preference_category
attributes.description: The category or domain of the preference (e.g., room type, pillow type, floor preference, amenity preferences, dietary restrictions, communication channel, language, newspaper, housekeeping schedule). Classifies the type of personalization being captured. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: room_type|pillow_type|floor_preference|amenity|dietary_restriction|communication_channel|language|newspaper|housekeeping_schedule — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: preference_source
attributes.description: The origin or channel through which this preference was captured (e.g., stated at enrollment, updated via mobile app, updated via website, captured by call center, inferred from stay history, imported from PMS profile).

attributes.name: preference_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of this preference record. Active preferences are used for personalization; inactive or expired preferences are retained for historical analysis.

attributes.name: preference_value
attributes.description: The specific value or selection for this preference (e.g., 'King Bed', 'Hypoallergenic Pillow', 'High Floor', 'Vegetarian', 'Email'). Free-text or structured value depending on category.

attributes.name: priority_rank
attributes.description: The priority or importance ranking of this preference relative to other preferences for the same member. Lower numbers indicate higher priority. Used when preferences conflict.

attributes.name: property_restriction
attributes.description: Indicates whether this preference applies to all properties, a specific property, a brand, or a region. Supports property-specific personalization.

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: The unique identifier for this preference record in the source system. Used for data lineage and reconciliation.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this preference record was last modified. Audit trail for record updates.

domains.name: channel
domains.description: Distribution channel management including OTA partnerships, GDS connectivity, direct booking channels, CRS (Sabre SynXis) channel mapping, and rate parity monitoring. Manages channel performance, commission structures, connectivity fees, booking source attribution, and channel mix optimization. Tracks cost of acquisition and channel contribution to revenue.
domains.references: HTNG Channel Distribution and CRS Connectivity Standard

products.name: channel
products.description: Master registry of all distribution channels through which Travel Hospitality properties sell inventory, including OTA platforms (Expedia, Booking.com), GDS networks (Sabre, Amadeus, Galileo), direct web/mobile, voice/call center, corporate direct, wholesalers, and metasearch engines. Captures channel type, connectivity method, commission tier, rate parity obligations, and channel-level SLA parameters. This is the SSOT for channel identity across the enterprise.

attributes.name: channel_id
attributes.description: Primary key for channel

attributes.name: hierarchy_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to property.hierarchy. Business justification: Distribution channels are managed and reported at regional/brand hierarchy nodes (e.g., EMEA OTA performance). Linking channel to hierarchy_id enables portfolio-level channel performance rollups witho

attributes.name: ota_partner_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to channel.ota_partner. Business justification: Many distribution channels are operated by OTA partners (e.g., Expedia operates multiple channels/brands). This FK establishes the ownership relationship. Removes redundant platform_name which can be

attributes.name: property_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to property.property. Business justification: Distribution channels incur operating costs (connectivity fees, commissions, marketing) that must be allocated to cost centers for USALI-compliant departmental P&L reporting and budget variance analys

attributes.name: activation_date
attributes.description: Date on which this distribution channel was first activated and began accepting live bookings. Distinct from contract_start_date which reflects the commercial agreement date. Used for channel onboarding tracking and performance benchmarking from go-live.
attributes.references: Sabre SynXis CRS; HTNG Channel Distribution Standards

attributes.name: bar_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether this channel is eligible to display and sell the Best Available Rate (BAR) — the lowest publicly available rate at the time of booking. True = BAR rates are distributed to this channel; False = channel receives only specific contracted or negotiated rates. Drives rate distribution strategy in IDeaS G3 RMS and Sabre SynXis CRS.
attributes.references: IDeaS G3 RMS; Sabre SynXis CRS; HTNG Channel Distribution Standards

attributes.name: booking_fee_usd
attributes.description: Per-transaction booking fee charged by the channel in addition to or instead of a commission percentage, expressed in USD. Common in GDS channels (e.g., GDS segment fee per booking). Used in cost-of-acquisition and channel profitability analysis.
attributes.references: USALI; AHLA Channel Distribution Best Practices; Sabre SynXis CRS

attributes.name: cancellation_policy_code
attributes.description: Code referencing the default cancellation policy applied to bookings made through this channel (e.g., '24H_FREE', '48H_PENALTY', 'NON_REFUNDABLE'). Cancellation policies may differ by channel based on contractual agreements. Managed in Oracle OPERA PMS and Sabre SynXis CRS.
attributes.references: Oracle OPERA PMS; Sabre SynXis CRS; HTNG

attributes.name: category
attributes.description: High-level grouping of the channel by booking relationship: DIRECT = guest books directly with the property (web, mobile, voice, corporate direct); INDIRECT = third-party intermediary involved (OTA, GDS, wholesaler, metasearch); OPAQUE = rate and property identity concealed until after booking (e.g., Hotwire, Priceline opaque). Drives cost-of-acquisition analysis and channel mix strategy.
attributes.references: AHLA Channel Distribution Best Practices; STR Channel Segmentation

attributes.name: channel_status
attributes.description: Current operational lifecycle status of the distribution channel. active = channel is live and accepting bookings; inactive = channel is configured but not currently selling; suspended = channel temporarily halted (e.g., rate parity violation, connectivity issue); pending_activation = channel onboarded but not yet live; decommissioned = channel permanently retired.
attributes.references: HTNG Channel Distribution Standards; Sabre SynXis CRS

attributes.name: channel_type
attributes.description: Categorical classification of the distribution channel by its market segment and technology interface. OTA = Online Travel Agency (e.g., Expedia, Booking.com); GDS = Global Distribution System (e.g., Sabre, Amadeus, Galileo); DIRECT_WEB = brand.com web booking; DIRECT_MOBILE = brand mobile app; VOICE = call center reservations; CORPORATE_DIRECT = negotiated corporate accounts; WHOLESALER = tour operators and bed banks; METASEARCH = Google Hotel Ads, Trivago. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: OTA|GDS|DIRECT_WEB|DIRECT_MOBILE|VOICE|CORPORATE_DIRECT|WHOLESALER|METASEARCH — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: HTNG Channel Distribution Standards; STR Channel Segmentation; AHLA

attributes.name: code
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric code uniquely identifying the distribution channel across enterprise systems including Sabre SynXis CRS, Oracle OPERA PMS, and IDeaS G3 RMS. Used for channel mapping and cross-system reconciliation.
attributes.references: Sabre SynXis CRS Channel Management; HTNG Channel Distribution Standards

attributes.name: commission_basis
attributes.description: The commercial model under which commission is calculated for this channel. NET_RATE = channel marks up a net rate provided by the property; GROSS_RATE = commission deducted from the gross rate charged to the guest; MARKUP = channel applies a markup over the property's net rate; FLAT_FEE = fixed fee per booking regardless of rate. Critical for accurate revenue and cost-of-acquisition reporting.
attributes.references: USALI; AHLA Channel Distribution Best Practices; STR

attributes.name: commission_rate_pct
attributes.description: Standard commission percentage charged by this distribution channel on each booking, expressed as a percentage of the room revenue (e.g., 15.00 for 15%). Drives cost-of-acquisition calculations and net revenue reporting per USALI standards. Confidential as it reflects negotiated commercial terms.
attributes.references: USALI (Uniform System of Accounts for the Lodging Industry); AHLA Channel Distribution Best Practices

attributes.name: connectivity_fee_usd
attributes.description: Annual or periodic connectivity/subscription fee charged by the channel or switch provider for maintaining the technical integration, expressed in USD. Included in total cost-of-acquisition analysis alongside commission. Confidential as it reflects negotiated commercial terms.
attributes.references: USALI; SAP S/4HANA Procurement MM; AHLA

attributes.name: connectivity_method
attributes.description: Technical integration method used to connect the property management system or CRS to this distribution channel. API = RESTful or SOAP API integration; XML = XML-based messaging (e.g., OTA XML); SFTP = file-based batch transfer; DIRECT_CONNECT = proprietary direct connection; SWITCH = via a channel manager switch (e.g., SiteMinder, Channex); MANUAL = manually managed extranet updates. Impacts SLA and rate update latency.
attributes.references: HTNG Channel Distribution Standards; Sabre SynXis CRS; AHLA Technology

attributes.name: content_distribution_enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether property content (room descriptions, images, amenities, policies) is actively distributed to this channel via a content API or content management system. True = content is pushed/synced to this channel; False = content is managed manually or not distributed. Relevant for OTA and metasearch channels.
attributes.references: HTNG Content Distribution Standards; AHLA Technology

attributes.name: contract_end_date
attributes.description: Date on which the commercial agreement with this distribution channel expires or is scheduled to terminate. Null for evergreen/open-ended agreements. Used for contract renewal management and channel lifecycle planning. Stored in yyyy-MM-dd format.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Procurement MM; USALI; SOX Financial Controls

attributes.name: contract_start_date
attributes.description: Date on which the commercial agreement with this distribution channel became effective. Used for contract lifecycle management, commission audit trails, and regulatory compliance. Stored in yyyy-MM-dd format.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Procurement MM; USALI; SOX Financial Controls

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this distribution channel record was first created in the enterprise data platform. Stored in yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX format. Used for audit trail, data lineage, and record lifecycle management.
attributes.references: SOX Financial Controls; GDPR Article 5 (Data Integrity); AHLA

attributes.name: crs_channel_code
attributes.description: Channel identifier as configured in the Sabre SynXis Central Reservation System (CRS). Used for cross-system reconciliation between the enterprise data lakehouse and the CRS source of record. Enables traceability of bookings back to the originating CRS channel configuration.

attributes.name: deactivation_date
attributes.description: Date on which this distribution channel was deactivated or decommissioned. Null for currently active channels. Used for channel lifecycle management, historical reporting, and audit trails. Stored in yyyy-MM-dd format.
attributes.references: Sabre SynXis CRS; HTNG Channel Distribution Standards; SOX

attributes.name: description
attributes.description: Free-text description of the distribution channel, including its market positioning, target guest segment, special contractual terms, or operational notes. Used for channel management documentation and onboarding reference.

attributes.name: gdpr_data_processor
attributes.business_glossary_term: General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) Data Processor Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this distribution channel acts as a GDPR data processor for guest personal data collected during the booking process. True = a Data Processing Agreement (DPA) is in place with this channel; False = channel does not process personal data on behalf of the property. Required for GDPR compliance and data governance.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 28 (Data Processing Agreements); CCPA; AHLA Data Privacy Standards

tag_set.value: General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) Data Processor Flag

attributes.name: gds_chain_code
attributes.description: Two-letter GDS chain code assigned to the hotel brand or property group within Global Distribution Systems (Sabre, Amadeus, Galileo/Travelport, Worldspan). Required for GDS-type channels to route availability and rate requests correctly. Null for non-GDS channels.
attributes.references: Sabre SynXis CRS; HTNG GDS Connectivity Standards; IATA GDS Standards

attributes.name: geographic_scope
attributes.description: Geographic reach of this distribution channel. GLOBAL = channel operates worldwide; REGIONAL = channel serves a specific geographic region (e.g., Asia-Pacific, Europe); DOMESTIC = channel serves a single country; LOCAL = channel serves a specific city or metro area. Used for channel mix strategy and market segmentation analysis.
attributes.references: AHLA Channel Distribution Best Practices; STR Channel Segmentation

attributes.name: inventory_allocation_method
attributes.description: Method by which room inventory is allocated to this distribution channel. POOLED = channel draws from the shared central inventory pool (real-time); ALLOTMENT = a fixed block of rooms is pre-allocated to the channel; FREE_SALE = channel can sell without prior allocation up to a defined limit; ON_REQUEST = bookings require manual confirmation. Managed in IDeaS G3 RMS and Sabre SynXis CRS.
attributes.references: IDeaS G3 RMS Inventory Controls; Sabre SynXis CRS; HTNG

attributes.name: last_room_availability
attributes.description: Indicates whether this channel has Last Room Availability (LRA) rights — meaning the property must make the last available room accessible through this channel at the contracted rate. LRA is a common contractual obligation in corporate and GDS agreements. True = LRA applies; False = LRA does not apply.
attributes.references: HTNG Channel Distribution Standards; IDeaS G3 RMS Inventory Controls; Sabre SynXis CRS

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this distribution channel record was most recently modified in the enterprise data platform. Stored in yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX format. Used for change tracking, data freshness monitoring, and audit compliance.
attributes.references: SOX Financial Controls; GDPR Article 5 (Data Integrity); AHLA

attributes.name: loyalty_bookings_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether bookings made through this channel are eligible for loyalty program points accrual and redemption. True = loyalty points are awarded and redeemable; False = bookings through this channel do not qualify for loyalty benefits (common for opaque OTA channels). Managed in Salesforce CRM Loyalty Management.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Loyalty Management; AHLA Loyalty Program Standards

attributes.name: mice_bookings_supported
attributes.business_glossary_term: Meetings Incentives Conferences Exhibitions (MICE) Bookings Supported Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this distribution channel supports group and MICE (Meetings, Incentives, Conferences, Exhibitions) bookings in addition to transient reservations. True = MICE/group bookings can be sourced through this channel; False = transient bookings only. Relevant for event sales and Delphi by Amadeus integration.
attributes.references: Delphi by Amadeus; HTNG; AHLA MICE Standards

tag_set.value: Meetings Incentives Conferences Exhibitions (MICE) Bookings Supported Flag

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Human-readable name of the distribution channel (e.g., 'Expedia Partner Central', 'Booking.com Extranet', 'Sabre GDS', 'Direct Web', 'Voice Reservations'). Used in reporting, dashboards, and channel mix analysis.
attributes.references: HTNG Channel Distribution Standards; AHLA Technology Standards

attributes.name: nrr_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether Non-Refundable Rate (NRR) products are distributed through this channel. True = NRR fences are available on this channel; False = only flexible/refundable rates are distributed. Impacts revenue management yield strategy and cancellation policy enforcement.
attributes.references: IDeaS G3 RMS; Sabre SynXis CRS; HTNG

attributes.name: payment_model
attributes.description: Defines who collects payment from the guest for bookings made through this channel. HOTEL_COLLECT = property collects payment directly at check-in/check-out; CHANNEL_COLLECT = the OTA or intermediary collects payment and remits net to the property; SPLIT = partial payment collected by each party. Impacts accounts receivable and revenue recognition per USALI and GAAP/IFRS.
attributes.references: USALI; GAAP/IFRS Revenue Recognition; SAP S/4HANA Finance; AHLA

attributes.name: pci_compliant
attributes.description: Indicates whether this distribution channel is certified as compliant with PCI DSS (Payment Card Industry Data Security Standard) for handling cardholder data. True = channel holds current PCI DSS certification; False = channel is not PCI compliant or certification has lapsed. Required for risk management and payment security governance.
attributes.references: PCI DSS (Payment Card Industry Data Security Standard); AHLA Technology

attributes.name: primary_market_country_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code of the primary market served by this distribution channel (e.g., 'USA', 'GBR', 'DEU'). Used for geographic channel mix analysis, market penetration reporting, and regulatory compliance (e.g., GDPR for EU-based channels).

attributes.name: priority_rank
attributes.description: Numeric rank indicating the strategic priority of this channel in the distribution mix, where lower numbers indicate higher priority (e.g., 1 = highest priority, typically direct web). Used by revenue management to determine inventory release sequencing and rate strategy. Configured in IDeaS G3 RMS and Sabre SynXis CRS.
attributes.references: IDeaS G3 RMS; Sabre SynXis CRS; AHLA Channel Distribution Best Practices

attributes.name: rate_parity_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether this distribution channel contractually requires rate parity — i.e., the property must offer the same or lower rates on this channel as on any other channel. True = rate parity clause is active in the channel agreement; False = no rate parity obligation. Critical for revenue management compliance and rate strategy.
attributes.references: AHLA Channel Distribution Best Practices; EU Rate Parity Regulations; HTNG

attributes.name: rate_parity_type
attributes.description: Specifies the scope of the rate parity obligation for this channel. BROAD = property must match rates across all channels including direct; NARROW = property must match rates on other OTAs but may offer lower rates on direct channels (common post-EU regulatory changes); NONE = no rate parity obligation. Drives revenue management and direct booking strategy.
attributes.references: EU Rate Parity Regulations; AHLA; HTNG Channel Distribution Standards

attributes.name: remittance_frequency
attributes.description: Frequency at which the channel remits collected payments to the property for CHANNEL_COLLECT payment model bookings. Applicable only when payment_model is CHANNEL_COLLECT or SPLIT. Drives accounts receivable forecasting and cash flow management in SAP S/4HANA.
attributes.references: USALI; SAP S/4HANA Finance AR; AHLA

attributes.name: sla_response_time_seconds
attributes.business_glossary_term: Channel Service Level Agreement (SLA) Response Time (Seconds)
attributes.description: Maximum allowable response time in seconds for availability and rate queries from this channel, as defined in the channel's Service Level Agreement (SLA). Used to monitor channel connectivity performance and enforce SLA compliance. Typical values: 3 seconds for OTA/GDS, 5 seconds for XML channels.
attributes.references: HTNG Channel Distribution Standards; Sabre SynXis CRS SLA; AHLA Technology

tag_set.value: Channel Service Level Agreement (SLA) Response Time (Seconds)

attributes.name: sla_uptime_pct
attributes.business_glossary_term: Channel Service Level Agreement (SLA) Uptime Percentage
attributes.description: Contractually committed uptime percentage for this channel's connectivity, expressed as a percentage (e.g., 99.90 for 99.9% uptime). Used to monitor channel reliability and enforce SLA penalties. Managed against actual uptime metrics in channel performance reporting.
attributes.references: HTNG Channel Distribution Standards; Sabre SynXis CRS SLA; AHLA Technology

tag_set.value: Channel Service Level Agreement (SLA) Uptime Percentage

attributes.name: supported_currencies
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of ISO 4217 three-letter currency codes supported by this distribution channel for booking and payment (e.g., 'USD,EUR,GBP,JPY'). Relevant for multi-currency rate distribution and foreign exchange management. Managed in Sabre SynXis CRS.
attributes.references: ISO 4217 Currency Codes; Sabre SynXis CRS; IFRS/GAAP

attributes.name: supported_languages
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of ISO 639-1 two-letter language codes supported by this channel for content display and guest communication (e.g., 'en,fr,de,zh,ja'). Relevant for content localization strategy and international market reach.
attributes.references: ISO 639-1 Language Codes; HTNG Content Distribution Standards

products.name: ota_partner
products.description: Master data for Online Travel Agency partners including Expedia, Booking.com, Agoda, Hotels.com, Airbnb, and regional OTAs. Captures partner legal entity, contract reference, commission rate tiers, connectivity protocol (XML/API/GDS), rate parity clause status, preferred partner designation, market coverage, and account management contacts. Distinct from the channel record — an OTA partner may operate multiple channels (desktop, mobile app, affiliate).

attributes.name: ota_partner_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the OTA partner record in the silver layer lakehouse. Primary key for the ota_partner master data product.
attributes.references: HTNG Data Dictionary; Sabre SynXis CRS Channel Management

attributes.name: property_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to property.property. Business justification: OTA account managers are employees managing partner relationships, negotiating contracts, and resolving disputes. Essential for accountability in partnership management, performance tracking, and esca

attributes.name: affiliate_network
attributes.description: Indicates whether the OTA partner operates an affiliate or sub-distribution network through which third-party websites or agents can book on behalf of the OTA. True = affiliate network active; False = direct OTA platform only. Relevant for booking source attribution accuracy.
attributes.references: Sabre SynXis CRS Channel Management; AHLA Channel Distribution Standards

attributes.name: base_commission_rate_pct
attributes.description: Standard commission percentage charged by the OTA partner on each confirmed booking, expressed as a percentage of the gross booking value (e.g., 15.00 = 15%). Foundational input for cost-of-acquisition (COA) and channel profitability analysis.
attributes.references: USALI Channel Cost Accounting; SAP S/4HANA Finance GL; AHLA Channel Distribution Standards

attributes.name: cancellation_policy_type
attributes.description: Default cancellation policy type applied to bookings made through this OTA channel. Flexible = free cancellation up to 24-48 hours; Moderate = partial penalty; Strict = high penalty; Non_Refundable = NRR (Non-Refundable Rate) — no refund on cancellation. Impacts revenue management and guest experience.
attributes.references: Oracle OPERA PMS Reservations; IDeaS G3 RMS; AHLA Channel Distribution Standards

attributes.name: channel_manager_platform
attributes.description: Name of the channel manager or switch platform used to manage the technical connectivity to this OTA partner (e.g., Sabre SynXis, Siteminder, Amadeus iHotelier, RateGain). Relevant when connectivity is not direct API-to-API.
attributes.references: Sabre SynXis CRS Channel Management; HTNG Distribution Channel Taxonomy

attributes.name: commission_model
attributes.description: Commercial model governing how the OTA partner earns revenue. Net Rate = hotel sells at net, OTA marks up; Merchant = OTA collects full payment and remits net; Agency = OTA collects commission on hotel-collected payment; Retail = standard published rate with commission; Opaque = rate hidden from consumer until post-booking (e.g., Hotwire).
attributes.references: USALI Channel Cost Accounting; AHLA Channel Distribution Standards; HTNG Distribution Channel Taxonomy

attributes.name: connectivity_fee_frequency
attributes.description: Frequency at which the connectivity fee is billed by the OTA partner or channel manager. Annual = yearly flat fee; Monthly = recurring monthly; Per_Booking = transactional fee per confirmed booking; One_Time = setup/onboarding fee only.
attributes.references: USALI Channel Cost Accounting; SAP S/4HANA Finance AP; AHLA Channel Distribution Standards

attributes.name: connectivity_fee_usd
attributes.description: Annual or per-transaction connectivity fee charged by the OTA partner or channel manager for maintaining the technical integration (API/XML/GDS switch). Expressed in USD. Used for total cost-of-acquisition (COA) calculation and channel profitability reporting per USALI.
attributes.references: USALI Channel Cost Accounting; SAP S/4HANA Finance GL; AHLA Channel Distribution Standards

attributes.name: connectivity_protocol
attributes.description: Technical protocol used for two-way inventory, rate, and availability (IRA) connectivity between the hotel's CRS/PMS and the OTA partner. XML = legacy XML push/pull; REST_API = modern RESTful API; GDS = Global Distribution System switch; SFTP = file-based batch; OTA_XML = OpenTravel Alliance XML standard; HTNG = HTNG web services.
attributes.references: HTNG Web Services Standard; OpenTravel Alliance (OTA) XML Schema; Sabre SynXis CRS

attributes.name: content_score
attributes.description: Numeric score (typically 0–100) representing the completeness and quality of the hotel's content (photos, descriptions, amenities) on the OTA partner's platform. Higher scores correlate with improved search ranking and conversion rates. Sourced from OTA partner reporting APIs.
attributes.references: AHLA Channel Distribution Standards; Medallia Experience Analytics

attributes.name: contract_effective_date
attributes.description: Date on which the master distribution agreement with the OTA partner becomes legally binding and operational. Governs the start of commission obligations and rate parity clauses.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Procurement MM; IFRS/GAAP; SOX Section 302

attributes.name: contract_expiry_date
attributes.description: Date on which the master distribution agreement with the OTA partner expires or is scheduled for renewal. Null indicates an evergreen/open-ended contract. Used for contract renewal management and risk monitoring.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Procurement MM; IFRS/GAAP; SOX Section 302

attributes.name: contract_reference
attributes.description: Unique reference number of the master distribution agreement or contract executed with the OTA partner. Links to the contract management repository in SAP S/4HANA for financial and legal audit purposes.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Procurement MM; SOX Section 302; AHLA Channel Distribution Standards

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the OTA partner record was first created in the data platform. Supports data lineage, audit trail, and silver layer ingestion tracking. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.
attributes.references: SOX Section 302; GDPR Article 5 (data integrity); SAP S/4HANA Audit Trail

attributes.name: data_sharing_agreement
attributes.description: Indicates whether a formal data sharing agreement (DSA) is in place with the OTA partner governing the exchange of guest booking data, anonymised analytics, and performance reporting. Required for GDPR and CCPA compliance when guest PII is transmitted.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 28; CCPA; AHLA Data Privacy Guidelines; PCI DSS

attributes.name: gdpr_data_processor
attributes.description: Indicates whether the OTA partner is formally designated as a GDPR Data Processor under Article 28, processing guest personal data on behalf of the hotel as Data Controller. True = Data Processing Agreement (DPA) executed; False = not designated as processor.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 28; AHLA Data Privacy Guidelines; CCPA

attributes.name: gds_chain_code
attributes.description: Two-letter chain code assigned by the Global Distribution System (GDS) to identify the hotel brand/chain within GDS networks (Sabre, Amadeus, Travelport). Applicable only when connectivity_protocol is GDS. Null for non-GDS OTA partners.
attributes.references: Sabre SynXis CRS; HTNG GDS Connectivity Standards; IATA GDS Standards

attributes.name: hq_country_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code of the country where the OTA partner's legal headquarters is registered. Used for tax treaty application, withholding tax determination, and regulatory jurisdiction identification.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1 Alpha-3; IFRS/GAAP; GDPR Article 4; SAP S/4HANA Finance

attributes.name: inventory_allocation_model
attributes.description: Model governing how room inventory is made available to the OTA partner. Free_Sell = real-time availability from CRS with no pre-allocated block; Allotment = pre-contracted room block allocated to the OTA; On_Request = bookings require manual confirmation. Managed in IDeaS G3 RMS and Sabre SynXis.
attributes.references: IDeaS G3 RMS Inventory Controls; Sabre SynXis CRS; AHLA Channel Distribution Standards

attributes.name: last_room_availability
attributes.description: Indicates whether the OTA partner contract includes a Last Room Availability (LRA) clause, requiring the hotel to make its last available room accessible to this channel. LRA clauses impact revenue management inventory controls and are tracked in IDeaS G3 RMS.
attributes.references: IDeaS G3 RMS Inventory Controls; AHLA Channel Distribution Standards; HTNG Distribution Channel Taxonomy

attributes.name: legal_entity_name
attributes.description: Full registered legal name of the OTA partner organisation as it appears on the master distribution agreement (e.g., Expedia, Inc.; Booking Holdings B.V.). Used for contract management, AP reconciliation, and regulatory filings.
attributes.references: IFRS/GAAP; SAP S/4HANA Vendor Master; AHLA Channel Distribution Standards

attributes.name: market_coverage
attributes.description: Description of the primary geographic markets or regions where the OTA partner has significant consumer reach and booking volume (e.g., 'North America, Western Europe'; 'Asia-Pacific'; 'Global'). Used for channel mix optimisation and market-specific distribution strategy.
attributes.references: AHLA Channel Distribution Standards; WTTC Tourism Distribution Standards

attributes.name: mobile_app_channel
attributes.description: Indicates whether the OTA partner operates a dedicated mobile application channel through which bookings are made. True = mobile app channel is active and tracked separately for attribution; False = desktop/web only. Supports channel mix and mobile booking trend analysis.
attributes.references: Sabre SynXis CRS Channel Management; AHLA Channel Distribution Standards

attributes.name: ota_account_manager_email
attributes.description: Business email address of the OTA partner's designated account manager. Used for commercial communications, promotional campaign coordination, and escalation. Classified as confidential PII per GDPR Article 4.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4; CCPA; Salesforce CRM Account Management

attributes.name: ota_account_manager_name
attributes.description: Full name of the OTA partner's designated account manager or market manager assigned to the hotel account. Primary point of contact for commercial negotiations, promotional campaigns, and issue resolution.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Account Management; AHLA Channel Distribution Standards

attributes.name: ota_account_manager_phone
attributes.description: Business phone number of the OTA partner's designated account manager. Used for urgent escalations and commercial negotiations. Classified as confidential PII per GDPR Article 4.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4; CCPA; Salesforce CRM Account Management

attributes.name: partner_code
attributes.description: Short alphanumeric code uniquely identifying the OTA partner within the Central Reservation System (CRS) and Property Management System (PMS). Used for channel mapping, rate distribution, and booking source attribution in Sabre SynXis and Oracle OPERA.
attributes.references: Sabre SynXis CRS Channel Management; Oracle OPERA PMS Reservations

attributes.name: partner_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the OTA partner relationship. Active = live and distributing inventory; Pending = contract under negotiation or connectivity setup in progress; Suspended = temporarily halted (e.g., rate parity breach); Terminated = contract ended.
attributes.references: Sabre SynXis CRS Channel Management; AHLA Channel Distribution Standards

attributes.name: partner_type
attributes.description: Classification of the distribution partner by channel category. OTA = Online Travel Agency (Expedia, Booking.com); GDS = Global Distribution System (Sabre, Amadeus); METASEARCH = price comparison engine (Google Hotel Ads, Trivago); DIRECT = brand.com or call centre; WHOLESALE = tour operator/bed bank; AFFILIATE = sub-affiliate network. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: OTA|GDS|METASEARCH|DIRECT|WHOLESALE|AFFILIATE — promote to reference product if additional types emerge]
attributes.references: AHLA Channel Distribution Standards; HTNG Distribution Channel Taxonomy

attributes.name: payment_collection_party
attributes.description: Identifies which party collects payment from the guest. Hotel = property collects at check-in/check-out (agency model); OTA = OTA collects full payment and remits net to hotel (merchant model); Split = partial payment collected by each party.
attributes.references: PCI DSS; USALI Channel Cost Accounting; Oracle OPERA PMS Cashiering

attributes.name: preferred_commission_rate_pct
attributes.description: Negotiated commission rate applicable when the property holds preferred partner or sponsored placement status with the OTA. Typically lower than the base rate in exchange for enhanced visibility or placement. Null if preferred status is not applicable.
attributes.references: USALI Channel Cost Accounting; AHLA Channel Distribution Standards

attributes.name: preferred_partner
attributes.description: Indicates whether the hotel or brand holds preferred partner or sponsored placement status with this OTA, typically in exchange for a higher commission rate or marketing investment. Preferred partners receive enhanced search ranking and visibility on the OTA platform.
attributes.references: AHLA Channel Distribution Standards; Sabre SynXis CRS Channel Management

attributes.name: primary_market_country_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code representing the OTA partner's primary consumer market or country of dominant booking volume (e.g., USA, GBR, SGP). Used for geographic channel attribution and market penetration analysis.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1 Alpha-3; WTTC Tourism Distribution Standards

attributes.name: rate_parity_clause
attributes.description: Indicates whether the OTA partner contract includes a rate parity clause requiring the hotel to offer rates no lower on other channels than those offered on this OTA. True = rate parity clause is active; False = no rate parity obligation. Critical for revenue management and legal compliance monitoring.
attributes.references: AHLA Channel Distribution Standards; EU Competition Law (rate parity regulations); HTNG Rate Parity Monitoring

attributes.name: rate_parity_type
attributes.description: Specifies the scope of the rate parity obligation. Broad = hotel cannot offer lower rates on ANY channel including its own website; Narrow = hotel cannot offer lower rates on OTHER OTAs but may offer lower rates on its own direct channels; None = no parity obligation. Relevant for EU regulatory compliance following rate parity investigations.
attributes.references: EU Competition Law; AHLA Channel Distribution Standards; HTNG Rate Parity Monitoring

attributes.name: remittance_cycle_days
attributes.description: Number of days after the guest check-out date within which the OTA partner remits commission payments or net booking proceeds to the hotel. Used for cash flow forecasting and AP/AR reconciliation in SAP S/4HANA (e.g., 30 = net-30 terms).
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Finance AP/AR; USALI Channel Cost Accounting; IFRS/GAAP

attributes.name: review_count
attributes.description: Total number of guest reviews published on the OTA partner's platform for the hotel. Used alongside review_score to assess statistical significance and platform engagement. Sourced from OTA partner reporting APIs.
attributes.references: Medallia Guest Feedback; AHLA Channel Distribution Standards

attributes.name: review_score
attributes.description: Average guest review score for the hotel as published on the OTA partner's platform (e.g., Booking.com score out of 10, Expedia score out of 5). Used for reputation management, competitive benchmarking, and NPS/GSS correlation analysis via Medallia.
attributes.references: Medallia Guest Feedback; AHLA Channel Distribution Standards; STR STAR Report

attributes.name: tax_registration_number
attributes.description: VAT, GST, or equivalent tax registration number of the OTA partner's legal entity. Required for tax invoice processing, withholding tax compliance, and AP reconciliation in SAP S/4HANA.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Finance GL/AP; IFRS/GAAP; SOX Section 302; Local Tax Regulations

attributes.name: trade_name
attributes.description: Consumer-facing brand name under which the OTA partner operates (e.g., Hotels.com, Agoda). May differ from the legal entity name when the OTA operates multiple consumer brands under one legal umbrella.
attributes.references: Sabre SynXis CRS Channel Management; AHLA Channel Distribution Standards

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the OTA partner record was most recently modified in the data platform. Used for change data capture (CDC), incremental ETL processing, and audit compliance. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.
attributes.references: SOX Section 302; GDPR Article 5 (data integrity); SAP S/4HANA Audit Trail

products.name: gds_connection
products.description: Master configuration record for each Global Distribution System connection (Sabre, Amadeus, Galileo/Travelport, Worldspan). Captures GDS network identifier, property chain code, pseudo city code (PCC), connectivity status, rate loading protocol, availability sync method, segment fee structure, and GDS-specific rate plan mappings. Supports GDS segment fee tracking and connectivity health monitoring.

attributes.name: gds_connection_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each GDS connection configuration record in the silver layer lakehouse. Primary key for this master configuration entity.

attributes.name: booking_source_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to channel.booking_source. Business justification: GDS connections are associated with specific booking source codes for attribution when reservations come through GDS channels. Many GDS connections per booking source. Removes redundant booking_source

attributes.name: channel_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent distribution channel record associated with this GDS connection, enabling channel mix analysis and cost-of-acquisition reporting.

attributes.name: property_id
attributes.description: Reference to the property for which this GDS connection is configured. Links the GDS connectivity record to the specific hotel or resort property.

attributes.name: activation_date
attributes.description: Date on which this GDS connection was first activated and made live for bookings. Used for contract term tracking, connectivity health history, and channel distribution reporting.

attributes.name: availability_sync_method
attributes.description: Method by which room availability is synchronized between the property management system and the GDS. Real-time provides instant updates; batch updates on a scheduled interval; on_request queries availability at booking time; seamless provides live two-way availability.
attributes.references: HTNG Availability Sync Standards; Oracle OPERA PMS GDS Interface

attributes.name: chain_code
attributes.description: Two- to four-character hotel chain code registered with the GDS network, identifying the hotel brand or management company within the GDS. Assigned by the GDS provider and used for inventory and rate loading.
attributes.references: Sabre SynXis CRS Chain Code Registry; HTNG GDS Connectivity Standards

attributes.name: commission_rate_pct
attributes.description: Percentage commission payable to travel agents or GDS intermediaries on bookings made through this GDS connection. Used for commission accrual, accounts payable processing, and channel cost analysis per USALI standards.
attributes.references: USALI Uniform System of Accounts for the Lodging Industry; GDS Agency Commission Agreement

attributes.name: connection_status
attributes.description: Current operational lifecycle status of the GDS connection. Active indicates live booking capability; suspended indicates temporary halt; pending_activation indicates setup in progress; decommissioned indicates permanently retired.

attributes.name: connectivity_fee_monthly_usd
attributes.description: Fixed monthly fee charged by the GDS provider or switch vendor for maintaining the technical connectivity of this GDS connection. Distinct from per-segment fees; used for OpEx budgeting and channel cost allocation.
attributes.references: GDS Connectivity Agreement; USALI Channel Distribution Cost Standards

attributes.name: connectivity_type
attributes.description: Technical connectivity model used for this GDS connection. Direct connect provides real-time two-way communication; switch connect routes through a switch provider; seamless provides full availability and rate transparency; standard uses batch updates.
attributes.references: HTNG GDS Connectivity Standards; Sabre SynXis CRS Technical Specifications

attributes.name: contract_end_date
attributes.description: Expiration date of the GDS connectivity contract. Null for evergreen contracts. Used for renewal alerts, contract renegotiation planning, and channel distribution continuity management.
attributes.references: GDS Distribution Agreement; USALI Contract Management

attributes.name: contract_start_date
attributes.description: Effective start date of the GDS connectivity contract governing this connection. Used for contract lifecycle management, renewal planning, and financial obligation tracking.
attributes.references: GDS Distribution Agreement; USALI Contract Management

attributes.name: corporate_rate_enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether negotiated corporate rates are loaded and accessible through this GDS connection. Corporate rates are a primary revenue stream for GDS channels and require specific rate plan configuration in the CRS.
attributes.references: Sabre SynXis CRS Corporate Rate Configuration; Oracle OPERA PMS Corporate Accounts

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this GDS connection configuration record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail, data lineage, and record lifecycle tracking in the silver layer lakehouse.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 5 (Data Integrity); SOX Internal Controls

attributes.name: crs_interface_code
attributes.description: Identifier for the CRS-to-GDS interface configuration within Sabre SynXis CRS. Links the GDS connection to the specific CRS interface instance managing rate distribution and availability synchronization.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code in which rates are loaded and displayed to travel agents in this GDS connection. Ensures rate accuracy and currency consistency for international GDS distribution.
attributes.references: ISO 4217 Currency Codes; IATA GDS Rate Standards

attributes.name: deactivation_date
